// turns the bundled base64 files back into real assets before vite runs
import fs from "node:fs";
fs.mkdirSync("src/assets", { recursive: true });
const rd = (f) => fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8").replace(/\s+/g, "");
fs.writeFileSync("src/assets/logo.jpg", Buffer.from(rd("assets/logo.b64"), "base64"));
fs.writeFileSync("src/assets/fontdata.js", `export default "${rd("assets/persian.ttf.b64")}";\n`);
console.log("logo.jpg + fontdata.js written");

#!/bin/bash
set -e
DEST=android/app/src/main/java/app/fraxinetum
mkdir -p "$DEST" android/app/src/main/java/android/print
cp native/PrintHtmlPlugin.java "$DEST/PrintHtmlPlugin.java"
cp native/MainActivity.java "$DEST/MainActivity.java"
cp native/KeepAlivePlugin.java "$DEST/KeepAlivePlugin.java"
cp native/CrawlService.java "$DEST/CrawlService.java"
cp native/NotifyPlugin.java "$DEST/NotifyPlugin.java"
cp native/BrowserFetchPlugin.java "$DEST/BrowserFetchPlugin.java"
cp native/PdfWriter.java android/app/src/main/java/android/print/PdfWriter.java

# allow plain-http sites to be archived
sed -i 's/<application/<application android:usesCleartextTraffic="true"/' android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml

# background download: permissions + foreground service
python3 - <<'PYM'
p = "android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml"
m = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
perms = "".join('<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.%s" />\n' % n for n in
    ("FOREGROUND_SERVICE", "FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC", "POST_NOTIFICATIONS", "WAKE_LOCK"))
perms += '<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="28" />\n'
m = m.replace("<application", perms + "<application", 1)
m = m.replace("</application>", '<service android:name=".CrawlService" android:exported="false" android:foregroundServiceType="dataSync" />\n</application>', 1)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(m)
print("manifest patched")
PYM

# fixed signing key: every build is signed the same way, so a new APK installs
# OVER the old one (data kept). Gradle's debug build reads this exact file.
mkdir -p ~/.android
base64 -d assets/debug.keystore.b64 > ~/.android/debug.keystore

# build number = GitHub run number (must grow for Android to accept an update)
N="${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER:-1}"
sed -i "s/versionCode [0-9]*/versionCode $N/; s/versionName \"[^\"]*\"/versionName \"1.$N\"/" android/app/build.gradle
grep -n "versionCode\|versionName" android/app/build.gradle

# app icon from the app picture
pip install --quiet --break-system-packages pillow 2>/dev/null || pip install --quiet pillow || true
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
im = Image.open("src/assets/logo.jpg").convert("RGB")
sizes = {"mdpi": 48, "hdpi": 72, "xhdpi": 96, "xxhdpi": 144, "xxxhdpi": 192}
for d, s in sizes.items():
    base = "android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-" + d
    sq = im.resize((s, s), Image.LANCZOS)
    sq.save(base + "/ic_launcher.png")
    mask = Image.new("L", (s * 4, s * 4), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).ellipse((0, 0, s * 4 - 1, s * 4 - 1), fill=255)
    mask = mask.resize((s, s), Image.LANCZOS)
    rd = Image.new("RGBA", (s, s), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    rd.paste(sq, (0, 0), mask)
    rd.save(base + "/ic_launcher_round.png")
print("icons written")
PY
# use the plain PNG icons on every Android version (drop the adaptive-icon xml)
rm -rf android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26

package app.fraxinetum;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.media.MediaScannerConnection;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Environment;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.print.PdfWriter;
import android.print.PrintDocumentAdapter;
import android.provider.MediaStore;
import android.webkit.WebView;
import android.webkit.WebViewClient;
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import androidx.core.content.FileProvider;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "PrintHtml")
public class PrintHtmlPlugin extends Plugin {
    private WebView pdfView;

    /* HTML -> PDF file directly (no print dialog), then saved into Download/FRAXINETUM */
    @PluginMethod
    public void toPdf(final PluginCall call) {
        final String html = call.getString("html", "");
        final String filename = call.getString("filename", "FRAXINETUM.pdf");
        getActivity().runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                pdfView = new WebView(getActivity());
                pdfView.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient() {
                    private boolean started = false;

                    @Override
                    public void onPageFinished(final WebView view, String url) {
                        if (started) return;
                        started = true;
                        // small delay so remote images finish drawing
                        new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(new Runnable() {
                            @Override
                            public void run() {
                                final File out = new File(getContext().getCacheDir(), "fx-" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".pdf");
                                PrintDocumentAdapter adapter = view.createPrintDocumentAdapter("FRAXINETUM");
                                PdfWriter.write(adapter, out, new PdfWriter.Done() {
                                    @Override
                                    public void onDone(boolean ok, String error) {
                                        if (!ok) {
                                            call.reject("PDF failed: " + error);
                                            return;
                                        }
                                        call.resolve(saveResult(out, filename, "application/pdf"));
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                        }, 700);
                    }
                });
                pdfView.loadDataWithBaseURL("https://localhost/", html, "text/html", "UTF-8", null);
            }
        });
    }

    /* copy a file from the app cache into Download/FRAXINETUM (the folder is created automatically) */
    @PluginMethod
    public void saveFile(final PluginCall call) {
        String path = call.getString("path", "");
        String name = call.getString("filename", "file");
        String mime = call.getString("mime", "application/octet-stream");
        call.resolve(saveResult(new File(path), name, mime));
    }

    /* open a saved file with whatever app can show it */
    @PluginMethod
    public void openFile(final PluginCall call) {
        try {
            Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW);
            i.setDataAndType(Uri.parse(call.getString("uri", "")), call.getString("mime", "*/*"));
            i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
            getContext().startActivity(i);
            call.resolve();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            call.reject("no app can open this file");
        }
    }

    private JSObject saveResult(File f, String name, String mime) {
        JSObject res = new JSObject();
        res.put("size", f.length());
        try {
            String[] r = saveToDownloads(f, name, mime);
            if (r == null) {
                res.put("saved", false);
                res.put("needsPermission", Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 29);
            } else {
                res.put("saved", true);
                res.put("location", r[0]);
                res.put("uri", r[1]);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            res.put("saved", false);
            res.put("error", String.valueOf(e));
        }
        return res;
    }

    private static void copy(InputStream is, OutputStream os) throws Exception {
        byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
        int n;
        while ((n = is.read(buf)) > 0) os.write(buf, 0, n);
    }

    /* returns { "Download/FRAXINETUM/<name>", "<content uri>" } or null when permission is missing */
    private String[] saveToDownloads(File f, String name, String mime) throws Exception {
        Context c = getContext();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
            ContentResolver resolver = c.getContentResolver();
            ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
            v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, name);
            v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, mime);
            v.put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, "Download/FRAXINETUM");
            Uri uri = resolver.insert(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, v);
            if (uri == null) throw new Exception("MediaStore insert failed");
            try (OutputStream os = resolver.openOutputStream(uri); InputStream is = new FileInputStream(f)) {
                copy(is, os);
            }
            return new String[]{"Download/FRAXINETUM/" + name, uri.toString()};
        }
        // Android 5-9: needs the storage permission
        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(c, Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(getActivity(), new String[]{Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE}, 8);
            return null;
        }
        File dir = new File(Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS), "FRAXINETUM");
        dir.mkdirs();
        File out = new File(dir, name);
        String base = name, ext = "";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot > 0) { base = name.substring(0, dot); ext = name.substring(dot); }
        int n = 1;
        while (out.exists()) { out = new File(dir, base + " (" + n + ")" + ext); n++; }
        try (OutputStream os = new FileOutputStream(out); InputStream is = new FileInputStream(f)) {
            copy(is, os);
        }
        MediaScannerConnection.scanFile(c, new String[]{out.getAbsolutePath()}, new String[]{mime}, null);
        Uri u = FileProvider.getUriForFile(c, c.getPackageName() + ".fileprovider", out);
        return new String[]{"Download/FRAXINETUM/" + out.getName(), u.toString()};
    }
}

#### FILE: native/PdfWriter.java ####
package android.print;

import android.os.CancellationSignal;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import java.io.File;

/* Lives in package android.print on purpose: the layout/write callbacks have
   package-private constructors. Writes a WebView print adapter straight to a PDF
   file — no print dialog, no preview. */
public class PdfWriter {
    public interface Done {
        void onDone(boolean ok, String error);
    }

    public static void write(final PrintDocumentAdapter adapter, final File file, final Done done) {
        PrintAttributes attrs = new PrintAttributes.Builder()
                .setMediaSize(PrintAttributes.MediaSize.ISO_A4)
                .setResolution(new PrintAttributes.Resolution("pdf", "pdf", 300, 300))
                .setMinMargins(PrintAttributes.Margins.NO_MARGINS)
                .build();
        adapter.onLayout(null, attrs, new CancellationSignal(), new PrintDocumentAdapter.LayoutResultCallback() {
            @Override
            public void onLayoutFinished(PrintDocumentInfo info, boolean changed) {
                try {
                    final ParcelFileDescriptor fd = ParcelFileDescriptor.open(file,
                            ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_WRITE
                                    | ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_CREATE
                                    | ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_TRUNCATE);
                    adapter.onWrite(new PageRange[]{PageRange.ALL_PAGES}, fd, new CancellationSignal(),
                            new PrintDocumentAdapter.WriteResultCallback() {
                                @Override
                                public void onWriteFinished(PageRange[] pages) {
                                    try { fd.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                                    done.onDone(true, null);
                                }

                                @Override
                                public void onWriteFailed(CharSequence error) {
                                    try { fd.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                                    done.onDone(false, String.valueOf(error));
                                }
                            });
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    done.onDone(false, String.valueOf(e));
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onLayoutFailed(CharSequence error) {
                done.onDone(false, String.valueOf(error));
            }
        }, null);
    }
}

package app.fraxinetum;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.Build;
import android.provider.Settings;
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "KeepAlive")
public class KeepAlivePlugin extends Plugin {

    @PluginMethod
    public void start(PluginCall call) {
        Context c = getContext();
        Intent i = new Intent(c, CrawlService.class);
        i.putExtra("text", call.getString("text", "در حال کار…"));
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) c.startForegroundService(i);
        else c.startService(i);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
                && ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(c, Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(getActivity(), new String[]{Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS}, 7);
        }
        call.resolve();
    }

    @PluginMethod
    public void update(PluginCall call) {
        Context c = getContext();
        NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager) c.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
        nm.notify(1, CrawlService.build(c, call.getString("text", "")));
        call.resolve();
    }

    @PluginMethod
    public void stop(PluginCall call) {
        Context c = getContext();
        c.stopService(new Intent(c, CrawlService.class));
        call.resolve();
    }

    @PluginMethod
    public void batterySettings(PluginCall call) {
        Intent i = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_SETTINGS);
        i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
        getContext().startActivity(i);
        call.resolve();
    }
}

#### FILE: native/CrawlService.java ####
package app.fraxinetum;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.PowerManager;
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat;

public class CrawlService extends Service {
    static final String CHANNEL = "fx_crawl";
    private PowerManager.WakeLock wakeLock;

    static Notification build(Context ctx, String text) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(CHANNEL, "FRAXINETUM", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ((NotificationManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE)).createNotificationChannel(ch);
        }
        Intent open = ctx.getPackageManager().getLaunchIntentForPackage(ctx.getPackageName());
        PendingIntent pi = PendingIntent.getActivity(ctx, 0, open, PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE | PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
        return new NotificationCompat.Builder(ctx, CHANNEL)
                .setContentTitle("FRAXINETUM")
                .setContentText(text)
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_sys_download)
                .setOngoing(true)
                .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
                .setContentIntent(pi)
                .build();
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        String text = intent != null && intent.getStringExtra("text") != null ? intent.getStringExtra("text") : "در حال کار…";
        Notification n = build(this, text);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
            startForeground(1, n, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_DATA_SYNC);
        } else {
            startForeground(1, n);
        }
        if (wakeLock == null) {
            PowerManager pm = (PowerManager) getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE);
            wakeLock = pm.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "fraxinetum:crawl");
            wakeLock.acquire(6 * 60 * 60 * 1000L);
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (wakeLock != null && wakeLock.isHeld()) wakeLock.release();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }
}

package app.fraxinetum;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat;
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;

/* Download notifications like a browser: "building…" with progress -> "دانلود انجام شد" (tap = open file) */
@CapacitorPlugin(name = "Notify")
public class NotifyPlugin extends Plugin {
    private static final String CHANNEL = "fx_downloads";

    private NotificationManager nm() {
        return (NotificationManager) getContext().getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
    }

    private NotificationCompat.Builder base() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            nm().createNotificationChannel(new NotificationChannel(CHANNEL, "دانلودها", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));
        }
        return new NotificationCompat.Builder(getContext(), CHANNEL).setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
    }

    private PendingIntent openApp(int id) {
        Intent open = getContext().getPackageManager().getLaunchIntentForPackage(getContext().getPackageName());
        return PendingIntent.getActivity(getContext(), id, open, PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE | PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
    }

    @PluginMethod
    public void begin(PluginCall call) {
        int id = call.getInt("id", 1);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
                && ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(getContext(), Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(getActivity(), new String[]{Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS}, 9);
        }
        nm().notify(id, base()
                .setContentTitle("FRAXINETUM")
                .setContentText(call.getString("text", ""))
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_sys_download)
                .setOngoing(true)
                .setProgress(0, 0, true)
                .setContentIntent(openApp(id))
                .build());
        call.resolve();
    }

    @PluginMethod
    public void progress(PluginCall call) {
        int id = call.getInt("id", 1);
        int pct = call.getInt("percent", 0);
        nm().notify(id, base()
                .setContentTitle("FRAXINETUM")
                .setContentText(call.getString("text", "") + " " + pct + "%")
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_sys_download)
                .setOngoing(true)
                .setProgress(100, pct, false)
                .setContentIntent(openApp(id))
                .build());
        call.resolve();
    }

    @PluginMethod
    public void done(PluginCall call) {
        int id = call.getInt("id", 1);
        String uri = call.getString("uri", "");
        PendingIntent pi = openApp(id);
        if (uri != null && !uri.isEmpty()) {
            Intent view = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW);
            view.setDataAndType(Uri.parse(uri), call.getString("mime", "*/*"));
            view.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
            pi = PendingIntent.getActivity(getContext(), id, view, PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE | PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
        }
        nm().notify(id, base()
                .setContentTitle(call.getString("title", "دانلود انجام شد"))
                .setContentText(call.getString("text", ""))
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_sys_download_done)
                .setOngoing(false)
                .setAutoCancel(true)
                .setContentIntent(pi)
                .build());
        call.resolve();
    }

    @PluginMethod
    public void fail(PluginCall call) {
        int id = call.getInt("id", 1);
        nm().notify(id, base()
                .setContentTitle("دانلود ناموفق بود")
                .setContentText(call.getString("text", ""))
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_notify_error)
                .setOngoing(false)
                .setAutoCancel(true)
                .setContentIntent(openApp(id))
                .build());
        call.resolve();
    }
}

package app.fraxinetum;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.webkit.ValueCallback;
import android.webkit.WebResourceError;
import android.webkit.WebResourceRequest;
import android.webkit.WebResourceResponse;
import android.webkit.WebSettings;
import android.webkit.WebView;
import android.webkit.WebViewClient;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import java.util.concurrent.Semaphore;
import org.json.JSONArray;

/* Opens a page in a hidden, real WebView (like a browser tab), waits until its text stops changing
   and returns the final HTML. Used when a plain download comes back empty or blocked, or for sites
   that build their pages with JavaScript. One page at a time. */
@CapacitorPlugin(name = "BrowserFetch")
public class BrowserFetchPlugin extends Plugin {
    private final Semaphore one = new Semaphore(1);
    private final Handler ui = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    @PluginMethod
    public void get(final PluginCall call) {
        final String url = call.getString("url", "");
        final int timeout = call.getInt("timeout", 35000);
        new Thread(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                try {
                    one.acquire();
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    call.reject("interrupted");
                    return;
                }
                ui.post(new Runnable() {
                    @Override
                    public void run() {
                        new Job(call, url, timeout).start();
                    }
                });
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private class Job {
        final PluginCall call;
        final String url;
        final int timeout;
        WebView wv;
        boolean done = false;
        int status = 200;
        int lastLen = -1;
        int stable = 0;
        final long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();

        Job(PluginCall call, String url, int timeout) {
            this.call = call;
            this.url = url;
            this.timeout = timeout;
        }

        @SuppressLint("SetJavaScriptEnabled")
        void start() {
            try {
                wv = new WebView(getActivity());
                WebSettings st = wv.getSettings();
                st.setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
                st.setDomStorageEnabled(true);
                st.setLoadsImagesAutomatically(false); // text only: do not download pictures
                st.setBlockNetworkImage(true);
                st.setUserAgentString(st.getUserAgentString().replace("; wv", ""));
                wv.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient() {
                    @Override
                    public void onReceivedHttpError(WebView v, WebResourceRequest r, WebResourceResponse resp) {
                        if (r.isForMainFrame()) status = resp.getStatusCode();
                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onReceivedError(WebView v, WebResourceRequest r, WebResourceError e) {
                        if (r.isForMainFrame()) finishError("load error: " + e.getDescription());
                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onPageStarted(WebView v, String u, android.graphics.Bitmap b) {
                        status = 200;
                    }
                });
                wv.loadUrl(url);
                ui.postDelayed(poll, 700);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                finishError(String.valueOf(e));
            }
        }

        final Runnable poll = new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                if (done) return;
                final boolean late = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0 > timeout;
                wv.evaluateJavascript(
                        "(function(){var b=document.body;return document.readyState+'|'+(b?b.innerText.length:0);})()",
                        new ValueCallback<String>() {
                            @Override
                            public void onReceiveValue(String v) {
                                if (done) return;
                                String s = v == null ? "" : v.replace("\"", "");
                                String[] p = s.split("\\|");
                                int len = 0;
                                try { len = Integer.parseInt(p.length > 1 ? p[1] : "0"); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                                boolean complete = p.length > 0 && "complete".equals(p[0]);
                                if (complete && len > 0 && len == lastLen) stable++; else stable = 0;
                                lastLen = len;
                                if (stable >= 2 || late) grab(); else ui.postDelayed(poll, 600);
                            }
                        });
            }
        };

        void grab() {
            wv.evaluateJavascript("(function(){return document.documentElement.outerHTML;})()", new ValueCallback<String>() {
                @Override
                public void onReceiveValue(String v) {
                    if (done) return;
                    try {
                        String html = new JSONArray("[" + v + "]").getString(0);
                        JSObject res = new JSObject();
                        res.put("html", html);
                        res.put("finalUrl", wv.getUrl());
                        res.put("status", status);
                        finish();
                        call.resolve(res);
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        finishError(String.valueOf(e));
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        void finishError(String msg) {
            if (done) return;
            finish();
            call.reject(msg);
        }

        void finish() {
            done = true;
            try {
                wv.stopLoading();
                wv.destroy();
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            one.release();
        }
    }
}

package app.fraxinetum;

import android.os.Bundle;
import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        registerPlugin(PrintHtmlPlugin.class);
        registerPlugin(KeepAlivePlugin.class);
        registerPlugin(NotifyPlugin.class);
        registerPlugin(BrowserFetchPlugin.class);
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        // keep JavaScript timers running while a download is in progress in the background
        try { getBridge().getWebView().resumeTimers(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }
}

#### FILE: src/format.js ####
export function faNum(n) {
  return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString("fa-IR");
}

export function formatFaDate(value) {
  if (!value || !String(value).trim()) return "";
  const raw = String(value).trim();
  const d = new Date(raw.length <= 10 ? raw + "T00:00:00" : raw);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return raw.slice(0, 10);
  try {
    return d.toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
  } catch (e) {
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

export function faLongDate(ts) {
  const d = ts ? new Date(ts) : new Date();
  try {
    return d.toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
  } catch (e) {
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

/* Persian font (Far.Nazanin, supplied by the user) + Times New Roman for Latin text. */
import fontB64 from "./assets/fontdata.js";

export const PERSIAN_FONT = "Far.Nazanin";
export const LATIN_FONT = "Times New Roman";

export function fontBytes() {
  const bin = atob(fontB64);
  const u = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) u[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return u;
}

/* @font-face used by the PDF/EPUB HTML: the Persian font only for Arabic-script
   characters, everything else falls through to Times New Roman / a serif. */
export function fontFaceCss() {
  return (
    `@font-face{font-family:'FxPersian';src:url(data:font/ttf;base64,${fontB64}) format('truetype');` +
    `unicode-range:U+0600-06FF,U+0750-077F,U+08A0-08FF,U+FB50-FDFF,U+FE70-FEFF,U+200C-200D}`
  );
}

export const BODY_FONT_STACK = "'FxPersian','Times New Roman','Liberation Serif','Noto Serif',serif";

/* User settings (saved on this phone) + applying theme / accent colour / font size / font. */
import { fontFaceCss } from "./fonts.js";

const KEY = "fx_settings";

export const DEFAULTS = {
  theme: "auto",       // auto | light | dark
  accent: "green",
  fontScale: 1,        // 0.9 | 1 | 1.15
  uiFont: "nazanin",   // nazanin | system
  partSize: 1000,      // max pages (or messages) per output part
  delay: 500,          // ms between requests
  robots: true,        // obey robots.txt by default
  notify: true,        // notification for every download
  checkUpdate: true,   // look for a new version on start
};

export const ACCENTS = {
  green:  { name: "سبز",     l: ["#123f39", "#17625a"], d: ["#35a596", "#46c2b1"] },
  blue:   { name: "آبی",     l: ["#17406b", "#1f5f9e"], d: ["#5aa2e6", "#7bb8ee"] },
  brown:  { name: "قهوه‌ای", l: ["#5b3a1e", "#7d5430"], d: ["#c79a6b", "#d9b388"] },
  purple: { name: "بنفش",    l: ["#4a2a6b", "#65408f"], d: ["#b58be0", "#c8a6ea"] },
  red:    { name: "قرمز",    l: ["#7a1f2b", "#a1303e"], d: ["#e87c8a", "#f09ca7"] },
};

export function getSettings() {
  try { return { ...DEFAULTS, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "{}") }; }
  catch (_e) { return { ...DEFAULTS }; }
}

export function setSetting(key, value) {
  const s = getSettings();
  s[key] = value;
  try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); } catch (_e) { /* private mode */ }
  applySettings();
}

export function resetSettings() {
  try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (_e) { /* ignore */ }
  applySettings();
}

/* how many pages (or messages) go into one output part */
export function pagesPerPart() {
  return Number(getSettings().partSize) || 1000;
}

function prefersDark() {
  try { return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches; } catch (_e) { return false; }
}

export function applySettings() {
  const s = getSettings();
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const dark = s.theme === "dark" || (s.theme === "auto" && prefersDark());
  if (s.theme === "auto") root.removeAttribute("data-theme"); else root.setAttribute("data-theme", s.theme);
  root.setAttribute("data-dark", dark ? "1" : "0");
  const acc = ACCENTS[s.accent] || ACCENTS.green;
  const [g, g2] = dark ? acc.d : acc.l;
  root.style.setProperty("--g", g);
  root.style.setProperty("--g2", g2);
  root.style.setProperty("--on", dark ? "#0d1412" : "#ffffff");
  root.style.setProperty("--fs", String(s.fontScale || 1));
  root.style.setProperty("--ff", s.uiFont === "system"
    ? "Tahoma,'Noto Naskh Arabic',sans-serif"
    : "'FxPersian','Times New Roman','Liberation Serif',serif");
  if (!document.getElementById("fx-font-face")) {
    const st = document.createElement("style");
    st.id = "fx-font-face";
    st.textContent = fontFaceCss();
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }
  const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
  if (meta) meta.setAttribute("content", g);
}

try {
  window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", () => applySettings());
} catch (_e) { /* old webview */ }

#### FILE: src/net.js ####
/* Native HTTP on Android (CapacitorHttp): no CORS limits, any site can be fetched. */
import { Capacitor, CapacitorHttp, registerPlugin } from "@capacitor/core";
import { decodeBytes } from "./site.js";

/* politeness: minimum gap between any two requests (also raised by robots.txt Crawl-delay) */
let minInterval = 500;
let nextAt = 0;
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
export function setRate(ms) { minInterval = Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0); }
export function getRate() { return minInterval; }
export function raiseRate(ms) { if (ms > minInterval) minInterval = ms; }
async function gate() {
  const now = Date.now();
  const at = Math.max(now, nextAt);
  nextAt = at + minInterval;
  if (at > now) await sleep(at - now);
}

/* looks like the phone's own browser: many sites refuse requests from unknown tools (the page
   then comes back empty), but serve the same page to a normal mobile browser */
const UA = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13; Pixel 7) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36";

function b64ToBytes(b64) {
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}

function lowerHeaders(h) {
  const out = {};
  if (h) for (const k of Object.keys(h)) out[k.toLowerCase()] = String(h[k]);
  return out;
}

function headerOf(h, name) {
  if (!h) return "";
  for (const k of Object.keys(h)) if (k.toLowerCase() === name) return String(h[k]);
  return "";
}

function lowerKeys(h) {
  const o = {};
  if (h) for (const k of Object.keys(h)) o[k.toLowerCase()] = String(h[k]);
  return o;
}

export async function fetchRaw(url, timeoutMs = 25000, accept = "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8", opts = {}) {
  if (opts.gate !== false) await gate();
  if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
    const r = await CapacitorHttp.get({
      url,
      headers: { "User-Agent": UA, Accept: accept, "Accept-Language": "fa-IR,fa;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7", "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests": "1" },
      responseType: "arraybuffer",
      connectTimeout: timeoutMs,
      readTimeout: timeoutMs,
    });
    return {
      status: r.status,
      bytes: typeof r.data === "string" ? b64ToBytes(r.data) : new Uint8Array(0),
      contentType: headerOf(r.headers, "content-type"),
      headers: lowerKeys(r.headers),
      url: r.url || url,
    };
  }
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ctl.signal, headers: { Accept: accept } });
    return {
      status: res.status,
      bytes: new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer()),
      contentType: res.headers.get("content-type") || "",
      headers: Object.fromEntries([...res.headers.entries()].map(([k, v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), v])),
      url: res.url || url,
    };
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

export async function fetchHtml(url, timeoutMs) {
  const r = await fetchRaw(url, timeoutMs);
  if (r.status >= 400) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
  if (r.contentType && !/text\/html|application\/xhtml|text\/plain|application\/xml|text\/xml/i.test(r.contentType)) {
    throw new Error("not-html");
  }
  return { html: decodeBytes(r.bytes, r.contentType), finalUrl: r.url };
}

export async function fetchText(url, timeoutMs = 15000) {
  try {
    const r = await fetchRaw(url, timeoutMs, "application/xml,text/xml,text/plain,*/*");
    if (r.status >= 400) return "";
    return decodeBytes(r.bytes, r.contentType);
  } catch (_e) {
    return "";
  }
}

export async function fetchJson(url, timeoutMs = 30000) {
  try {
    const r = await fetchRaw(url, timeoutMs, "application/json");
    if (r.status !== 200) return null;
    return { json: JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(r.bytes)), headers: r.headers };
  } catch (_e) {
    return null;
  }
}

/* Android only: load the page in a real (hidden) WebView — like opening it in a browser. It runs the
   page's JavaScript, keeps cookies and passes the simple "checking your browser" screens. */
const BrowserFetch = registerPlugin("BrowserFetch");
export const hasBrowser = () => Capacitor.isNativePlatform();

export async function fetchViaBrowser(url, timeoutMs = 35000) {
  await gate();
  const r = await BrowserFetch.get({ url, timeout: timeoutMs });
  if (r.status >= 400) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
  return { html: r.html || "", finalUrl: r.finalUrl || url, via: "browser" };
}

#### FILE: src/fetcher.js ####
/* One careful way to download an HTML page:
   - an empty / "checking your browser" / blocked answer is NOT treated as a page without text;
   - it is retried (slower each time), and the last try opens the page in a real WebView (Android);
   - the whole crawl slows itself down when a site starts refusing, and stops (instead of marking
     thousands of pages) when the site clearly blocks us. */
import { fetchHtml, fetchViaBrowser, hasBrowser, getRate, setRate } from "./net.js";

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

const CHALLENGE_RE = /(_Incapsula_Resource|incapsula incident|cf-browser-verification|cf-challenge|challenge-platform|just a moment|checking your browser|attention required|access denied|request unsuccessful|px-captcha|g-recaptcha|h-captcha|are you (a )?(human|robot)|ddos-guard|arvancloud|pardon our interruption|bot detection|enable javascript and cookies|you have been blocked|please verify you are|تایید هویت|در حال بررسی مرورگر)/i;

/* "" when the HTML looks like a real page, otherwise a short Persian reason */
export function blockedReason(html) {
  const raw = String(html || "");
  if (!raw.trim()) return "پاسخ سرور خالی بود";
  const text = raw.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, " ").replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, " ").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const hasTitle = /<title[^>]*>\s*[^<\s][^<]*<\/title>/i.test(raw);
  const hasH1 = /<h1[\s>]/i.test(raw);
  if (CHALLENGE_RE.test(raw.slice(0, 30000)) && text.length < 1500) return "سایت صفحهٔ بررسی یا مسدودسازی ضدربات نشان داد";
  if (!hasTitle && !hasH1 && text.length < 80) return "سایت پاسخ بدون عنوان و بدون محتوا داد (احتمالاً دسترسی را محدود کرده است)";
  return "";
}

export class BlockedAbort extends Error {}

export function makeFetcher(project) {
  const base = Number(project.delay_ms) || 500;
  const mode = project.fetch_mode || "auto"; // auto | browser
  const scale = project.retry_scale == null ? 1 : Number(project.retry_scale); // 1 = real waits (tests use less)
  const st = { streak: 0, okRun: 0, hardFails: 0, cooled: 0 };

  const noteOk = () => {
    st.streak = 0; st.hardFails = 0; st.okRun += 1;
    if (st.okRun >= 20 && getRate() > base) { setRate(Math.max(base, Math.round(getRate() * 0.7))); st.okRun = 0; }
  };
  const noteBad = async () => {
    st.okRun = 0; st.streak += 1;
    setRate(Math.min(8000, Math.max(getRate(), base) * 1.6));      // slow down
    if (st.streak >= 6 && st.cooled < 3) { st.cooled += 1; st.streak = 0; await sleep(25000 * scale); } // let the site calm down
  };

  async function get(url) {
    let reason = "";
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
      try {
        const useBrowser = hasBrowser() && (mode === "browser" || attempt === 2);
        const res = useBrowser ? await fetchViaBrowser(url) : await fetchHtml(url, 25000);
        const why = blockedReason(res.html);
        if (!why) { noteOk(); return res; }
        reason = why;
      } catch (e) {
        const msg = String((e && e.message) || e);
        if (/^HTTP (404|410)\b/.test(msg) || msg === "not-html") throw e; // a real "not found" / not a page: no retry
        reason = msg;
      }
      await noteBad();
      if (attempt < 2) await sleep((attempt === 0 ? 3000 : 9000) * scale);
    }
    st.hardFails += 1;
    if (st.hardFails >= 8) throw new BlockedAbort("سایت پشت‌سرهم پاسخ خالی یا مسدودکننده می‌دهد؛ ادامه داده نشد تا صفحه‌ها اشتباه «بدون متن» ثبت نشوند. بعداً دوباره امتحان کنید، تأخیر را بیشتر کنید یا «روش دریافت: مرورگر داخلی» را بزنید.");
    throw new Error(reason || "پاسخ نامعتبر");
  }
  return { get };
}

/* robots.txt: obey Disallow/Allow and Crawl-delay for our user-agent (fallback: "*"). */
import { fetchText } from "./net.js";

const UA_NAME = "fraxinetum";

function patToRegex(pat) {
  let p = pat.replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&").replace(/\*/g, ".*");
  if (p.endsWith("\\$")) p = p.slice(0, -2) + "$";
  return new RegExp("^" + p);
}

export async function loadRobots(origin) {
  const txt = await fetchText(origin + "/robots.txt", 12000);
  const groups = [];
  let cur = null;
  let lastWasAgent = false;
  txt.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((raw) => {
    const line = raw.replace(/#.*$/, "").trim();
    const i = line.indexOf(":");
    if (i < 0) return;
    const k = line.slice(0, i).trim().toLowerCase();
    const v = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
    if (k === "user-agent") {
      if (!cur || !lastWasAgent) { cur = { agents: [], rules: [], delay: 0 }; groups.push(cur); }
      cur.agents.push(v.toLowerCase());
      lastWasAgent = true;
      return;
    }
    lastWasAgent = false;
    if (!cur) return;
    if (k === "disallow" || k === "allow") {
      if (k === "disallow" && v === "") return;
      try { cur.rules.push({ allow: k === "allow", len: v.length, re: patToRegex(v) }); } catch (_e) { /* bad pattern */ }
    } else if (k === "crawl-delay") {
      cur.delay = Math.min(30, parseFloat(v) || 0);
    }
  });
  const g = groups.find((x) => x.agents.some((a) => a !== "*" && UA_NAME.includes(a))) || groups.find((x) => x.agents.includes("*")) || null;

  return {
    found: groups.length > 0,
    delay: g ? g.delay : 0,
    allowed(url) {
      if (!g) return true;
      let path = "/";
      try { const u = new URL(url); path = u.pathname + u.search; } catch (_e) { return true; }
      let best = null;
      for (const r of g.rules) {
        if (r.re.test(path) && (!best || r.len > best.len || (r.len === best.len && r.allow))) best = r;
      }
      return best ? best.allow : true;
    },
  };
}

/* URL helpers, sitemap reading and link extraction (ported from the Base44 version). */
import { fetchText } from "./net.js";

const FILE_EXT = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|svg|bmp|ico|css|js|mjs|json|xml|rss|atom|pdf|zip|rar|gz|7z|tar|mp3|mp4|m4a|webm|avi|mov|wmv|woff2?|ttf|eot|otf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|exe|dmg|apk)$/i;
const SKIP_PATH = /(\/wp-admin|\/wp-login|\/wp-json|\/xmlrpc|\/feed|\/rss|\/login|\/signin|\/signup|\/register|\/logout|\/cart|\/checkout|\/account|\/my-account|\/search|\/tag\/|\/tags\/|\/author\/|\/page\/\d+|\/cdn-cgi\/)/i;
const TRACKING = /^(utm_|fbclid|gclid|mc_|_ga|replytocom)/i;

export function normalizeUrl(href, base) {
  if (!href) return null;
  const h = String(href).trim();
  if (!h || h.startsWith("#")) return null;
  if (/^(javascript|mailto|tel|data|blob|whatsapp|sms|ftp|file):/i.test(h)) return null;
  try {
    const u = new URL(h, base);
    if (u.protocol !== "http:" && u.protocol !== "https:") return null;
    u.hash = "";
    const drop = [];
    u.searchParams.forEach((_v, k) => { if (TRACKING.test(k)) drop.push(k); });
    drop.forEach((k) => u.searchParams.delete(k));
    let s = u.toString();
    if (u.pathname !== "/" && s.endsWith("/") && !u.search) s = s.slice(0, -1);
    return s;
  } catch (_e) {
    return null;
  }
}

export function firstTextOf(...values) {
  for (const v of values) if (v && String(v).trim()) return String(v).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return "";
}

export function bareHost(url) {
  try { return new URL(url).host.replace(/^www\./i, "").toLowerCase(); } catch (_e) { return ""; }
}

export function pathOf(url) {
  try { return decodeURIComponent(new URL(url).pathname); } catch (_e) { return url; }
}

export function sectionOf(url) {
  const parts = pathOf(url).split("/").filter(Boolean);
  return parts.length ? parts[0] : "";
}

/* same host, not a file, not a login/search/tag style page */
export function isCrawlable(url, host) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (host && bareHost(url) !== host) return false;
    if (FILE_EXT.test(u.pathname)) return false;
    if (SKIP_PATH.test(u.pathname)) return false;
    return true;
  } catch (_e) {
    return false;
  }
}

export function decodeBytes(bytes, contentType) {
  let charset = "";
  const m = /charset=["']?([\w-]+)/i.exec(contentType || "");
  if (m) charset = m[1];
  if (!charset) {
    const head = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: false }).decode(bytes.slice(0, 5000));
    const mm = /charset=["']?([\w-]+)/i.exec(head);
    if (mm) charset = mm[1];
  }
  let norm = (charset || "utf-8").toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^cp1256$/, "windows-1256");
  if (!norm) norm = "utf-8";
  try { return new TextDecoder(norm, { fatal: false }).decode(bytes); }
  catch (_e) { return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: false }).decode(bytes); }
}

export function readSiteName(html) {
  const root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
  const og = root.querySelector('meta[property="og:site_name"]');
  const t = root.querySelector("title");
  return String((og && og.getAttribute("content")) || (t && t.textContent) || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 160);
}

export function parseSitemapXml(xml) {
  const urls = [];
  const children = [];
  const lastmods = {};
  const re = /<(url|sitemap)[\s>][\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi;
  const locRe = /<loc>\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*<\/loc>/i;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(xml))) {
    const loc = locRe.exec(m[0]);
    if (!loc) continue;
    const value = loc[1].trim().replace(/&amp;/g, "&").replace(/^<!\[CDATA\[|\]\]>$/g, "");
    if (!value) continue;
    if (m[1].toLowerCase() === "sitemap") children.push(value);
    else {
      urls.push(value);
      const lm = /<lastmod>\s*([^<\s]+)\s*<\/lastmod>/i.exec(m[0]);
      if (lm) { const t = Date.parse(lm[1]); if (!Number.isNaN(t)) lastmods[value] = t; }
    }
  }
  return { urls, children, lastmods };
}

export async function collectSitemapUrls(rootUrl, limit) {
  const origin = new URL(rootUrl).origin;
  const queue = [];
  const seenSm = new Set();
  const found = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const lastmod = {};
  let sitemapUrl = "";

  const robots = await fetchText(origin + "/robots.txt", 12000);
  robots.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line) => {
    const mm = /^\s*sitemap\s*:\s*(\S+)/i.exec(line);
    if (mm) queue.push(mm[1].trim());
  });
  if (!queue.length) {
    queue.push(origin + "/sitemap.xml", origin + "/sitemap_index.xml", origin + "/sitemap-index.xml", origin + "/sitemap1.xml");
  }

  let visited = 0;
  while (queue.length && visited < 400 && found.length < limit) {
    const sm = queue.shift();
    if (!sm || seenSm.has(sm)) continue;
    seenSm.add(sm);
    visited += 1;
    const xml = (await fetchText(sm, 20000)).slice(0, 8000000);
    if (!xml) continue;
    const parsed = parseSitemapXml(xml);
    if (parsed.urls.length || parsed.children.length) sitemapUrl = sitemapUrl || sm;
    parsed.children.forEach((c) => queue.push(c));
    for (const u of parsed.urls) {
      if (found.length >= limit) break;
      const n = normalizeUrl(u, sm);
      if (n && !seen.has(n)) { seen.add(n); found.push(n); if (parsed.lastmods[u]) lastmod[n] = parsed.lastmods[u]; }
    }
  }
  return { urls: found, sitemapUrl, lastmod };
}

/* every internal link of the WHOLE page (menus included) */
export function extractLinks(html, baseUrl, host) {
  const root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
  const out = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  root.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach((a) => {
    const abs = normalizeUrl(a.getAttribute("href"), baseUrl);
    if (!abs || seen.has(abs)) return;
    if (!isCrawlable(abs, host)) return;
    seen.add(abs);
    out.push(abs);
  });
  return out;
}

/* WordPress fast path: the site's own REST API gives clean article HTML in bulk
   (up to 100 per request) instead of downloading and cleaning every page. */
import { fetchJson } from "./net.js";

const FIELDS_LIST = "id,link,date_gmt,modified_gmt";
const FIELDS_FULL = "id,link,date_gmt,modified_gmt,title,content";

export async function probeWp(origin) {
  const types = [];
  for (const type of ["posts", "pages"]) {
    const r = await fetchJson(`${origin}/wp-json/wp/v2/${type}?per_page=1&_fields=id`);
    if (!r || !Array.isArray(r.json)) { if (type === "posts") return null; continue; }
    const total = Number(r.headers["x-wp-total"]) || r.json.length;
    if (total > 0) types.push({ type, total });
  }
  return types.length ? types : null;
}

/* every post/page address (oldest first) with its modified time */
export async function listWp(origin, type, onItems, shouldStop) {
  for (let page = 1; page < 5000; page++) {
    if (shouldStop?.()) return false;
    const r = await fetchJson(`${origin}/wp-json/wp/v2/${type}?per_page=100&page=${page}&orderby=date&order=asc&_fields=${FIELDS_LIST}`);
    if (!r || !Array.isArray(r.json) || !r.json.length) break;
    onItems(r.json.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, link: x.link, modified: x.modified_gmt || "", type })));
    const totalPages = Number(r.headers["x-wp-totalpages"]) || 0;
    if (totalPages && page >= totalPages) break;
  }
  return true;
}

const attr = (s) => String(s || "").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");

/* returns { [id]: htmlDocument } ready for extractPage() */
export async function fetchWpBatch(origin, type, ids) {
  const r = await fetchJson(`${origin}/wp-json/wp/v2/${type}?include=${ids.join(",")}&per_page=100&_fields=${FIELDS_FULL}`);
  if (!r || !Array.isArray(r.json)) return null;
  const out = {};
  for (const it of r.json) {
    const title = (it.title && it.title.rendered) || "";
    const content = (it.content && it.content.rendered) || "";
    out[it.id] = {
      link: it.link,
      html:
        `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${title}</title>` +
        `<meta property="og:title" content="${attr(title)}">` +
        `<meta property="article:published_time" content="${attr(it.date_gmt)}Z">` +
        `<meta property="article:modified_time" content="${attr(it.modified_gmt)}Z"></head>` +
        `<body><article><h1>${title}</h1>${content}</article></body></html>`,
    };
  }
  return out;
}

import { normalizeUrl, pathOf, sectionOf, firstTextOf } from "./site.js";

const JUNK_RE = /(^|[-_ ])(sidebar|widget|navbar|menu|comment|comments|sharing|social|advert|advertisement|ads|banner|breadcrumb|breadcrumbs|pagination|pager|popup|modal|newsletter|subscribe|subscription|cookie|related|recommend|recommended|post-tags|tags-list|entry-meta|meta-box|author-box|toolbar|skip-link|rating|rating-box|share|sharedaddy|sd-sharing|sd-block|addtoany|a2a_kit|jp-relatedposts|yarpp-related|essb_links|heateor_sss_sharing_container)([-_ ]|$)/i;

const DROP_TAGS = new Set([
  "script", "style", "noscript", "template", "svg", "canvas", "form", "button", "input",
  "select", "option", "textarea", "label", "iframe", "video", "audio", "object", "embed",
  "map", "nav", "header", "footer", "aside", "link", "meta", "base", "dialog",
]);

const ALLOWED = new Set([
  "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "p", "ul", "ol", "li", "blockquote", "pre", "code",
  "figure", "figcaption", "table", "thead", "tbody", "tr", "td", "th", "caption",
  "strong", "b", "em", "i", "u", "br", "hr", "sub", "sup", "dl", "dt", "dd", "mark",
]);


const MAX_CONTENT = 110000;

function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
}

function escapeAttr(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
}

function tagOf(el) {
  return String((el && (el.rawTagName || el.tagName)) || "").toLowerCase();
}

function attrOf(el, name) {
  return (el && el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute(name)) || "";
}

function isJunk(el) {
  const blob = attrOf(el, "class") + " " + attrOf(el, "id") + " " + attrOf(el, "role");
  return JUNK_RE.test(blob);
}

function textLen(el) {
  if (!el) return 0;
  return (el.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().length;
}

function textOf(el) {
  return el ? String(el.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() : "";
}

/* strict: class/id based junk removal (sidebars, menus, share buttons…) but NEVER an element that wraps
   the page's main text or contains the page heading (Elementor/Divi style wrappers are called "widget",
   "menu-…", "share-enabled"… and used to be deleted together with the whole article).
   lenient: only structural junk + a short list of names that never wrap an article. */
const CORE_JUNK_RE = /(^|[-_ ])(sidebar|comments|comment-list|comment-respond|breadcrumb|breadcrumbs|cookie|cookies|popup|modal|newsletter|sharedaddy|sd-sharing|addtoany|a2a_kit|jp-relatedposts|yarpp-related|skip-link|pagination)([-_ ]|$)/i;

function stripJunk(root, mode) {
  const body = root.querySelector("body") || root;
  const bodyLen = textLen(body);
  root.querySelectorAll("*").forEach((el) => {
    const tag = tagOf(el);
    if (tag === "form" && textLen(el) > 1500) return; // ASP.NET-style sites wrap the whole page in <form>
    if (DROP_TAGS.has(tag)) {
      if ((tag === "header" || tag === "footer" || tag === "aside" || tag === "nav") && mode === "lenient" && textLen(el) > 0.6 * bodyLen && bodyLen > 500) return;
      el.remove();
      return;
    }
    if (/^(html|body|main|article)$/.test(tag)) return;
    const blob = attrOf(el, "class") + " " + attrOf(el, "id") + " " + attrOf(el, "role");
    if (mode === "lenient") {
      if (/(^|\s)(navigation|banner|contentinfo|complementary)(\s|$)/.test(attrOf(el, "role")) || CORE_JUNK_RE.test(blob)) el.remove();
      return;
    }
    if (JUNK_RE.test(blob)) {
      const len = textLen(el);
      const wraps = bodyLen > 600 && len > 0.35 * bodyLen;
      if (wraps || el.querySelector("h1") || /^(content|post|entry|article)/i.test(attrOf(el, "id"))) return; // keep the wrapper, junk inside is still removed
      el.remove();
    }
  });
}

function depthOf(el) {
  let d = 0;
  let cur = el;
  while (cur && cur.parentNode) {
    d += 1;
    cur = cur.parentNode;
    if (d > 40) break;
  }
  return d;
}

function pickContainer(root) {
  const body = root.querySelector("body") || root;
  const candidates = root.querySelectorAll("article, main, div, section, td");
  let best = null;
  let bestScore = -1;
  candidates.forEach((el) => {
    const total = textLen(el);
    if (total < 250) return;
    let linkText = 0;
    el.querySelectorAll("a").forEach((a) => {
      linkText += textLen(a);
    });
    const content = Math.max(0, total - linkText);
    if (content < 200) return;
    const density = content / Math.max(1, total);
    const tag = tagOf(el);
    const bonus = tag === "article" ? 250 : tag === "main" ? 150 : 0;
    const score = content * (0.4 + 0.6 * density) + bonus + depthOf(el) * 4;
    if (score > bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      best = el;
    }
  });
  return best || body;
}

function jsonLdNodes(root) {
  const nodes = [];
  root.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]').forEach((s) => {
    let txt = s.rawText || s.textContent || "";
    txt = txt.replace(/^\s*<!\[CDATA\[/, "").replace(/\]\]>\s*$/, "").trim();
    if (!txt) return;
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(txt);
      const push = (v) => {
        if (!v) return;
        if (Array.isArray(v)) {
          v.forEach(push);
          return;
        }
        if (typeof v !== "object") return;
        if (v["@graph"]) push(v["@graph"]);
        nodes.push(v);
      };
      push(data);
    } catch (_e) {
      /* malformed json-ld is ignored */
    }
  });
  return nodes;
}

function typeOfNode(node) {
  const t = node && node["@type"];
  return (Array.isArray(t) ? t.join(",") : String(t || "")).toLowerCase();
}

function joinValue(v) {
  if (!v) return "";
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(joinValue).filter(Boolean).join("، ");
  if (typeof v === "object") return firstTextOf(v.name, v["@id"], v.url);
  return String(v);
}

function metaContentOf(root, sel) {
  const el = root.querySelector(sel);
  return el ? attrOf(el, "content") : "";
}

function readMeta(root, url) {
  const nodes = jsonLdNodes(root);
  const article = nodes.find((n) => /article|blogposting|newsarticle|posting|webpage|report/.test(typeOfNode(n))) || nodes[0] || {};
  const h1 = root.querySelector("h1");
  const titleEl = root.querySelector("title");
  const timeEl = root.querySelector("time[datetime]");

  const title = firstTextOf(
    article.headline,
    article.name,
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="og:title"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="twitter:title"]'),
    h1 ? h1.textContent : "",
    titleEl ? titleEl.textContent : "",
  );

  const published = firstTextOf(
    joinValue(article.datePublished),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="article:published_time"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="date"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="pubdate"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[itemprop="datePublished"]'),
    timeEl ? attrOf(timeEl, "datetime") : "",
    timeEl ? timeEl.textContent : "",
  );

  const updated = firstTextOf(
    joinValue(article.dateModified),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="article:modified_time"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="last-modified"]'),
  );

  let author = article.author ? joinValue(article.author) : "";
  author = firstTextOf(
    author,
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="author"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="article:author"]'),
    textOf(root.querySelector('[rel="author"]')),
    textOf(root.querySelector(".author-name")),
  );
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(author)) author = "";

  const description = firstTextOf(
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="description"]'),
    metaContentOf(root, 'meta[property="og:description"]'),
    joinValue(article.description),
  );

  let category = joinValue(article.articleSection);
  if (!category) {
    const crumbs = root.querySelectorAll('[class*="breadcrumb" i] a');
    if (crumbs.length) category = textOf(crumbs[crumbs.length - 1]);
  }
  if (!category) category = sectionOf(url);

  const keywords = firstTextOf(metaContentOf(root, 'meta[name="keywords"]'), joinValue(article.keywords));
  const tags = keywords
    ? keywords.split(/[,،]/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 12)
    : [];

  return { title, published, updated, author, description, category, tags: tags.join("، ") };
}

function walk(node, ctx, out) {
  const children = node.childNodes || [];
  for (const child of children) {
    if (child.nodeType === 3) {
      const t = child.textContent || "";
      if (t.trim()) out.push(escapeHtml(t.replace(/\s+/g, " ")));
      continue;
    }
    if (child.nodeType !== 1) continue;
    const tag = tagOf(child);
    if (!tag) continue;
    if (DROP_TAGS.has(tag) && !(tag === "form" && textLen(child) > 1500)) continue; // class-based junk was already removed by stripJunk()

    // text only: pictures are never extracted (a figure keeps just its caption)
    if (tag === "img" || tag === "picture" || tag === "svg" || tag === "video" || tag === "audio" || tag === "canvas") continue;
    if (tag === "figure") {
      const cap = child.querySelector("figcaption");
      const t = cap ? textOf(cap) : "";
      if (t) out.push("<p>" + escapeHtml(t) + "</p>");
      continue;
    }

    if (tag === "a") {
      const href = normalizeUrl(attrOf(child, "href"), ctx.base);
      const inner = [];
      walk(child, ctx, inner);
      const body = inner.join("").trim();
      if (!body) continue;
      if (href && ctx.links.length < 150 && !ctx.seenLink.has(href) && href !== ctx.base) {
        ctx.seenLink.add(href);
        ctx.links.push(href);
      }
      out.push(href ? '<a href="' + escapeAttr(href) + '">' + body + "</a>" : body);
      continue;
    }

    if (ALLOWED.has(tag)) {
      const inner = [];
      walk(child, ctx, inner);
      const joined = inner.join("").trim();
      if (!joined) continue;
      if (/^(h[1-6]|p|li|blockquote|td|th|figcaption)$/.test(tag)) {
        out.push("<" + tag + ">" + joined + "</" + tag + ">");
      } else {
        out.push("<" + tag + ">" + joined + "</" + tag + ">");
      }
      continue;
    }

    walk(child, ctx, out);
  }
}

function tidy(html) {
  let out = html;
  out = out.replace(/<(p|li|h[1-6]|blockquote|figcaption)>\s*<\/\1>/g, "");
  out = out.replace(/(<br\s*\/?>\s*){2,}/g, "<br/>");
  out = out.replace(/<p>\s*(<br\s*\/?>\s*)+/g, "<p>");
  out = out.replace(/(\s*<br\s*\/?>\s*)+<\/p>/g, "</p>");
  out = out.replace(/<p>\s*&nbsp;\s*<\/p>/g, "");
  out = out.replace(/\s{3,}/g, " ");
  return out.trim();
}

export function plainText(html) {
  return String(html || "")
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

/* one pass: parse -> strip -> pick container -> walk */
function runPass(html, url, mode) {
  const root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
  const meta = readMeta(root, url);
  if (mode === "body") {
    root.querySelectorAll("script, style, noscript, template, iframe, svg, nav, header, footer, aside").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  } else {
    stripJunk(root, mode);
  }
  const container = mode === "body" ? root.querySelector("body") || root : pickContainer(root);
  const ctx = { links: [], seenLink: new Set(), base: url };
  const out = [];
  walk(container, ctx, out);
  let contentHtml = tidy(out.join(""));
  const titlePlain = plainText(meta.title);
  const leading = /^\s*<h[12][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h[12]>/i.exec(contentHtml);
  if (leading && plainText(leading[1]) === titlePlain) contentHtml = contentHtml.slice(leading[0].length).trim();
  const plain = plainText(contentHtml);
  const words = plain ? plain.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length : 0;
  return { meta, container, ctx, contentHtml, plain, words, mode };
}

export function extractPage(html, url) {
  // 1) strict, 2) lenient, 3) whole body text — the first one that yields real text wins, so a page
  //    that has text is never reported as empty just because of unusual class names.
  let best = runPass(html, url, "strict");
  if (best.words < 40) {
    const lenient = runPass(html, url, "lenient");
    if (lenient.words > best.words) best = lenient;
  }
  if (best.words < 25) {
    const body = runPass(html, url, "body");
    if (body.words > best.words) best = body;
  }
  const { meta, container, ctx, plain, words } = best;
  let contentHtml = best.contentHtml;

  const headings = [];
  container.querySelectorAll("h1, h2, h3, h4").forEach((h) => {
    const t = textOf(h);
    if (t && t.length > 1 && headings.length < 40 && headings[headings.length - 1] !== t) headings.push(t.slice(0, 180));
  });

  let truncated = false;
  if (contentHtml.length > MAX_CONTENT) {
    contentHtml = contentHtml.slice(0, MAX_CONTENT);
    truncated = true;
  }
  const plainFinal = truncated ? plainText(contentHtml) : plain;
  const wordCount = truncated ? plainFinal.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length : words;

  return {
    title: meta.title || pathOf(url),
    has_title: !!meta.title,
    author: meta.author || "",
    published_date: meta.published || "",
    updated_date: meta.updated || "",
    category: meta.category || "",
    description: meta.description || "",
    tags: meta.tags || "",
    section: sectionOf(url),
    path: pathOf(url),
    headings,
    images: [],
    image_count: 0,
    outbound_links: ctx.links.slice(0, 100),
    content_html: contentHtml,
    text_preview: plainFinal.slice(0, 700),
    word_count: wordCount,
    extract_mode: best.mode,
    truncated,
    status: "extracted",
    links_parsed: true,
    error: "",
  };
}

/* Everything lives in this phone's IndexedDB: projects, page list, article text. */
const DB_NAME = "fraxinetum";
let dbp = null;

function db() {
  if (dbp) return dbp;
  dbp = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 4);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const d = req.result;
      if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("projects")) d.createObjectStore("projects", { keyPath: "id" });
      if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("pages")) {
        const pages = d.createObjectStore("pages", { keyPath: "id" });
        pages.createIndex("project_id", "project_id");
      }
      if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("content")) d.createObjectStore("content");
      if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("media")) d.createObjectStore("media"); // Telegram photos
      if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("downloads")) d.createObjectStore("downloads", { keyPath: "id" }); // saved outputs history
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
  return dbp;
}

const wait = (tx) =>
  new Promise((res, rej) => {
    tx.oncomplete = () => res();
    tx.onerror = () => rej(tx.error);
    tx.onabort = () => rej(tx.error || new Error("حافظهٔ گوشی پر است یا عملیات لغو شد."));
  });

const asPromise = (req) =>
  new Promise((res, rej) => { req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result); req.onerror = () => rej(req.error); });

export async function requestPersistence() {
  try { if (navigator.storage?.persist) await navigator.storage.persist(); } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }
}

export async function listProjects() {
  const d = await db();
  const all = await asPromise(d.transaction("projects").objectStore("projects").getAll());
  return all.sort((a, b) => (b.created || 0) - (a.created || 0));
}

export async function saveProject(p) {
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("projects", "readwrite");
  tx.objectStore("projects").put(p);
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function loadPages(projectId) {
  const d = await db();
  const rows = await asPromise(d.transaction("pages").objectStore("pages").index("project_id").getAll(projectId));
  return rows.sort((a, b) => (a.order_index || 0) - (b.order_index || 0));
}

export async function savePages(pages) {
  if (!pages.length) return;
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("pages", "readwrite");
  const st = tx.objectStore("pages");
  pages.forEach((p) => { const { __content, ...rest } = p; st.put(rest); });
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function putContent(items) {
  if (!items.length) return;
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("content", "readwrite");
  const st = tx.objectStore("content");
  items.forEach((it) => st.put(it.html, it.id));
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function getContentMap(ids, onProgress) {
  const d = await db();
  const map = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 50) {
    const slice = ids.slice(i, i + 50);
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = d.transaction("content");
      const st = tx.objectStore("content");
      slice.forEach((id) => { const r = st.get(id); r.onsuccess = () => { if (r.result) map[id] = r.result; }; });
      tx.oncomplete = resolve;
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
    onProgress?.(Math.min(i + 50, ids.length), ids.length);
  }
  return map;
}

export async function deleteProject(projectId) {
  const d = await db();
  const pages = await loadPages(projectId);
  const tx = d.transaction(["projects", "pages", "content", "media"], "readwrite");
  pages.forEach((p) => { tx.objectStore("pages").delete(p.id); tx.objectStore("content").delete(p.id); });
  tx.objectStore("media").delete(IDBKeyRange.bound(projectId + "|", projectId + "|\uffff"));
  tx.objectStore("projects").delete(projectId);
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function putMedia(key, buf, type) {
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("media", "readwrite");
  tx.objectStore("media").put({ buf, type }, key);
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function getMediaMap(keys, onProgress) {
  const d = await db();
  const map = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i += 30) {
    const slice = keys.slice(i, i + 30);
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = d.transaction("media");
      const st = tx.objectStore("media");
      slice.forEach((k) => { const r = st.get(k); r.onsuccess = () => { if (r.result) map[k] = r.result; }; });
      tx.oncomplete = resolve;
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
    onProgress?.(Math.min(i + 30, keys.length), keys.length);
  }
  return map;
}

/* ---- history of saved outputs (the «دانلودها» page) ---- */
export async function addDownload(rec) {
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("downloads", "readwrite");
  tx.objectStore("downloads").put(rec);
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function listDownloads() {
  const d = await db();
  const all = await asPromise(d.transaction("downloads").objectStore("downloads").getAll());
  return all.sort((a, b) => (b.created || 0) - (a.created || 0));
}

export async function deleteDownload(id) {
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("downloads", "readwrite");
  tx.objectStore("downloads").delete(id);
  await wait(tx);
}

export async function clearDownloads() {
  const d = await db();
  const tx = d.transaction("downloads", "readwrite");
  tx.objectStore("downloads").clear();
  await wait(tx);
}
