/* Android foreground service: keeps a long download alive when the screen turns off
   or the app goes to the background (shows an ongoing notification). */
import { Capacitor, registerPlugin } from "@capacitor/core";

const KeepAlive = registerPlugin("KeepAlive");
const native = () => Capacitor.isNativePlatform();
let lastUpdate = 0;

export async function kaStart(text) {
  if (!native()) return;
  try { await KeepAlive.start({ text }); } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }
}
export async function kaUpdate(text) {
  if (!native() || Date.now() - lastUpdate < 2500) return;
  lastUpdate = Date.now();
  try { await KeepAlive.update({ text }); } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }
}
export async function kaStop() {
  if (!native()) return;
  try { await KeepAlive.stop(); } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }
}
export async function openBatterySettings() {
  if (!native()) return;
  try { await KeepAlive.batterySettings(); } catch (_e) { /* optional */ }
}

#### FILE: src/crawler.js ####
/* Phases (all on the phone):
   runDiscovery   – walk the WHOLE site (WordPress API, sitemap or internal links), only collect/count addresses
   runExtraction  – download + extract the first N pages (N = ceiling chosen by the user)
   runIncremental – look for NEW / CHANGED pages only, then extract just those
   Politeness: robots.txt (Disallow + Crawl-delay) and a minimum gap between requests. */
import { setRate, raiseRate } from "./net.js";
import { makeFetcher, BlockedAbort } from "./fetcher.js";
import { collectSitemapUrls, extractLinks, isCrawlable, normalizeUrl, bareHost, pathOf, sectionOf, readSiteName } from "./site.js";
import { extractPage } from "./extract.js";
import { loadRobots } from "./robots.js";
import { probeWp, listWp, fetchWpBatch } from "./wp.js";
import * as store from "./store.js";

export const HARD_LIMIT = 500000;
const SCAN_BATCH = 12;

async function load(project) {
  const pages = await store.loadPages(project.id);
  const known = new Set(pages.map((p) => p.url));
  const byUrl = new Map(pages.map((p) => [p.url, p]));
  const host = bareHost(project.site_url);
  const origin = new URL(project.site_url).origin;
  const st = { nextN: project.next_n || pages.length, dirty: [] };

  setRate(project.delay_ms || 500);
  let robots = null;
  if (project.respect_robots !== false) {
    try {
      robots = await loadRobots(origin);
      if (robots.delay) raiseRate(robots.delay * 1000);
    } catch (_e) { robots = null; }
  }

  const addPage = (url, parsed, extra) => {
    if (known.has(url) || pages.length >= HARD_LIMIT || !isCrawlable(url, host)) return null;
    if (robots && !robots.allowed(url)) { project.robots_blocked = (project.robots_blocked || 0) + 1; return null; }
    known.add(url);
    const p = {
      id: `${project.id}|${st.nextN}`, project_id: project.id, url,
      path: pathOf(url), section: sectionOf(url), order_index: st.nextN,
      status: "pending", links_parsed: !!parsed, chunk_count: 0, word_count: 0, image_count: 0,
      ...(extra || {}),
    };
    st.nextN += 1;
    pages.push(p);
    byUrl.set(url, p);
    st.dirty.push(p);
    return p;
  };

  const flush = async () => {
    project.next_n = st.nextN;
    project.discovered = pages.length;
    project.updated = Date.now();
    const out = st.dirty; st.dirty = [];
    await store.savePages(out);
    await store.saveProject(project);
  };
  const fetcher = makeFetcher(project);
  project.last_error = "";
  return { pages, byUrl, host, origin, robots, st, addPage, flush, fetcher };
}

/* follow internal links of every page that was not scanned yet */
async function scanUnparsed(c, project, { onProgress, shouldStop }) {
  const { pages, host, st, addPage, flush, fetcher } = c;
  let abortMsg = "";
  const skipRun = new Set(); // pages that could not be read in this run: retried next time, never treated as "no links"
  let skipReason = "";
  const scanOne = async (page) => {
    try {
      const { html, finalUrl } = await fetcher.get(page.url);
      return { page, links: extractLinks(html, finalUrl || page.url, host), html };
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof BlockedAbort) { abortMsg = e.message; return { page, links: [], html: "", abort: true }; }
      const msg = String((e && e.message) || e).slice(0, 160);
      if (/^HTTP (404|410)\b/.test(msg) || msg === "not-html") return { page, links: [], html: "", dead: msg }; // a real dead link / not a page
      return { page, links: [], html: "", failed: msg };
    }
  };
  let idx = pages.findIndex((p) => !p.links_parsed);
  if (idx < 0) idx = pages.length;
  const open = (p) => !p.links_parsed && !skipRun.has(p);
  let scanned = project.scanned || 0;
  let capped = pages.length >= HARD_LIMIT;

  while (!shouldStop() && !capped) {
    while (idx < pages.length && !open(pages[idx])) idx += 1;
    if (idx >= pages.length) break;
    const batch = [];
    for (let j = idx; j < pages.length && batch.length < SCAN_BATCH; j++) if (open(pages[j])) batch.push(pages[j]);
    const results = [];
    let cur = 0;
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(3, batch.length) }, async () => {
      while (cur < batch.length) results.push(await scanOne(batch[cur++]));
    }));
    for (const r of results) {
      if (r.abort) continue; // blocked by the site: leave it unscanned so it is tried again later
      if (r.failed) { skipRun.add(r.page); skipReason = skipReason || r.failed; r.page.discover_error = r.failed; st.dirty.push(r.page); continue; }
      r.page.links_parsed = true;
      if (r.dead) r.page.discover_error = r.dead;
      st.dirty.push(r.page);
      r.links.forEach((l) => addPage(l, false));
      if (!project.site_name && r.html && r.page.order_index === 0) project.site_name = readSiteName(r.html);
    }
    scanned += results.filter((r) => !r.abort).length;
    project.scanned = scanned;
    capped = pages.length >= HARD_LIMIT;
    if (abortMsg) { project.last_error = abortMsg; await flush(); break; }
    await flush();
    onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned });
  }
  return { capped, finished: !abortMsg && skipRun.size === 0 && (capped || !pages.some((p) => !p.links_parsed)), scanned, skipped: skipRun.size, skipReason };
}

/* ---------------- phase 1: walk the whole site and count it ---------------- */
export async function runDiscovery(project, opts) {
  const { onProgress, shouldStop } = opts;
  await store.requestPersistence();
  const c = await load(project);
  const { pages, origin, robots, addPage, flush } = c;
  project.status = "discovering";

  if (!project.seeded) {
    // 1) WordPress REST API (fast, clean)
    let wp = null;
    if (!robots || robots.allowed(origin + "/wp-json/")) {
      try { wp = await probeWp(origin); } catch (_e) { wp = null; }
    }
    if (wp) {
      project.wp = true;
      for (const t of wp) {
        await listWp(origin, t.type, (items) => {
          items.forEach((it) => addPage(normalizeUrl(it.link, origin) || it.link, true, { wp_type: it.type, wp_id: it.id, wp_modified: it.modified }));
          onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned: 0 });
        }, shouldStop);
      }
    }
    // 2) sitemap, 3) internal links
    if (!wp) {
      const root = normalizeUrl(project.site_url, project.site_url);
      if (root) addPage(root, false);
      try {
        const sm = await collectSitemapUrls(project.site_url, HARD_LIMIT);
        if (sm.urls.length) {
          project.sitemap_found = true;
          project.sitemap_url = sm.sitemapUrl;
          sm.urls.forEach((u) => addPage(u, true, sm.lastmod[u] ? { sitemap_lastmod: sm.lastmod[u] } : undefined));
        }
      } catch (_e) { /* no sitemap: internal links are followed instead */ }
    }
    project.seeded = true;
    await flush();
    onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned: 0 });
  }

  const r = await scanUnparsed(c, project, opts);
  if (r.finished) {
    project.discovery_done = true;
    project.capped = r.capped;
    project.status = "discovered";
    if (!project.site_name) project.site_name = project.domain;
  } else {
    project.status = "paused";
    if (r.skipped && !project.last_error) {
      project.last_error = `برای ${r.skipped} صفحه پاسخ معتبری دریافت نشد (${r.skipReason}). پیمایش کامل نیست؛ «ادامهٔ پیمایش سایت» را بزنید، یا تأخیر را بیشتر کنید، یا «روش دریافت: مرورگر داخلی» را انتخاب کنید.`;
    }
  }
  await flush();
  onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned: r.scanned, done: r.finished });
  return project;
}

/* ---------------- phase 2: download + extract the first N pages ---------------- */
export async function runExtraction(project, { onProgress, shouldStop, retryFailed = false }) {
  await store.requestPersistence();
  const c = await load(project);
  const { pages, origin, robots, st, flush, fetcher } = c;
  let abortMsg = "";
  const target = Math.min(Number(project.max_pages) || 0, pages.length);
  const active = pages.slice(0, target);

  if (retryFailed) {
    active.forEach((p) => { if (p.status === "failed") { p.status = "pending"; p.error = ""; st.dirty.push(p); } });
  }
  let extracted = 0, failed = 0;
  active.forEach((p) => { if (p.status === "extracted") extracted += 1; else if (p.status === "failed") failed += 1; });
  project.status = "extracting";
  const report = () => onProgress?.({ phase: "extract", discovered: pages.length, target, extracted, failed });
  const sync = async () => { project.extracted = extracted; project.failed = failed; await flush(); report(); };
  await sync();

  const useWp = !!project.wp && (!robots || robots.allowed(origin + "/wp-json/"));
  const batchSize = useWp ? 30 : 8;

  const htmlOne = async (page) => {
    try {
      const { html, finalUrl } = await fetcher.get(page.url);
      const data = extractPage(html, finalUrl || page.url);
      if (!data.word_count && !data.has_title) return { page, ok: false, error: "سایت پاسخ بدون عنوان و محتوا داد (احتمالاً دسترسی را محدود کرده است)" };
      return { page, ok: true, data };
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof BlockedAbort) { abortMsg = e.message; return { page, ok: false, abort: true }; }
      return { page, ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e).slice(0, 180) };
    }
  };

  let ptr = 0;
  while (!shouldStop()) {
    while (ptr < active.length && active[ptr].status !== "pending") ptr += 1;
    if (ptr >= active.length) break;
    const batch = [];
    for (let j = ptr; j < active.length && batch.length < batchSize; j++) if (active[j].status === "pending") batch.push(active[j]);

    const results = [];
    const rest = [];
    if (useWp) {
      const groups = {};
      batch.forEach((p) => { if (p.wp_id) (groups[p.wp_type] = groups[p.wp_type] || []).push(p); else rest.push(p); });
      for (const type of Object.keys(groups)) {
        const got = await fetchWpBatch(origin, type, groups[type].map((p) => p.wp_id)).catch(() => null);
        for (const p of groups[type]) {
          const item = got && got[p.wp_id];
          if (item) {
            try { results.push({ page: p, ok: true, data: extractPage(item.html, item.link || p.url) }); }
            catch (e) { results.push({ page: p, ok: false, error: String(e.message || e).slice(0, 180) }); }
          } else rest.push(p); // API gave nothing for it: download the normal page
        }
      }
    } else rest.push(...batch);

    let cur = 0;
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(3, rest.length) }, async () => {
      while (cur < rest.length) results.push(await htmlOne(rest[cur++]));
    }));

    const contentRows = [];
    for (const r of results) {
      const p = r.page;
      if (r.abort) continue; // stays "pending" (never written as failed / empty)
      st.dirty.push(p);
      if (!r.ok) { p.status = "failed"; p.error = r.error; failed += 1; continue; }
      const { content_html, outbound_links, text_preview, updated_date, ...meta } = r.data;
      Object.assign(p, meta, { modified_date: updated_date || "", status: "extracted", error: "", fetched_at: Date.now(), chunk_count: content_html ? 1 : 0 });
      if (content_html) contentRows.push({ id: p.id, html: content_html });
      extracted += 1;
    }
    try {
      await store.putContent(contentRows);
    } catch (e) {
      throw new Error("ذخیرهٔ متن روی گوشی ناموفق بود (شاید حافظه پر است): " + String((e && e.message) || e));
    }
    await sync();
    if (abortMsg) { project.last_error = abortMsg; break; }
  }

  const left = active.some((p) => p.status === "pending");
  project.status = left ? "paused" : "ready";
  if (!left) project.finished = Date.now();
  await sync();
  return project;
}

/* ---------------- incremental update: only new / changed pages ---------------- */
export async function runIncremental(project, opts) {
  const { onProgress, shouldStop } = opts;
  await store.requestPersistence();
  const c = await load(project);
  const { pages, byUrl, origin, robots, addPage, flush } = c;
  const before = pages.length;
  const allCeiling = (Number(project.max_pages) || 0) >= before; // user had chosen "all pages"
  let changed = 0;
  project.status = "discovering";
  onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned: 0 });

  const markChanged = (p) => { if (p.status === "extracted" || p.status === "failed") { p.status = "pending"; p.error = ""; c.st.dirty.push(p); changed += 1; } };

  if (project.wp && (!robots || robots.allowed(origin + "/wp-json/"))) {
    for (const type of ["posts", "pages"]) {
      await listWp(origin, type, (items) => {
        items.forEach((it) => {
          const url = normalizeUrl(it.link, origin) || it.link;
          const p = byUrl.get(url);
          if (!p) addPage(url, true, { wp_type: it.type, wp_id: it.id, wp_modified: it.modified });
          else if (it.modified && p.wp_modified && it.modified > p.wp_modified) { p.wp_modified = it.modified; markChanged(p); }
        });
      }, shouldStop);
    }
  } else if (project.sitemap_found) {
    const sm = await collectSitemapUrls(project.site_url, HARD_LIMIT);
    sm.urls.forEach((u) => {
      const p = byUrl.get(u);
      if (!p) addPage(u, true, sm.lastmod[u] ? { sitemap_lastmod: sm.lastmod[u] } : undefined);
      else if (sm.lastmod[u] && (p.sitemap_lastmod || p.fetched_at || 0) < sm.lastmod[u]) { p.sitemap_lastmod = sm.lastmod[u]; markChanged(p); }
    });
  } else {
    // no sitemap / API: re-read the home page and the first pages (menus, lists) for new links
    pages.slice(0, 40).forEach((p) => { p.links_parsed = false; c.st.dirty.push(p); });
  }
  await flush();

  const r = await scanUnparsed(c, project, opts);
  project.discovery_done = true;
  const added = pages.length - before;
  project.last_incremental = { at: Date.now(), added, changed };
  if (allCeiling) project.max_pages = pages.length;
  project.status = "extracting";
  await flush();
  onProgress?.({ phase: "discover", discovered: pages.length, scanned: r.scanned, done: true });
  if (shouldStop()) { project.status = "paused"; await flush(); return project; }
  await runExtraction(project, { onProgress, shouldStop });
  return project;
}

#### FILE: src/documentBuilder.js ####
/* Builds clean, Word-friendly and printable archive documents, split into parts
   so that very large sites do not blow past the read-traffic or memory limits.
   The body is rendered from the extracted HTML into a small set of block-level
   tags with fully-escaped text, so no raw tag (such as <strong>) ever leaks into
   the final file — the reader sees exactly the text a normal visitor sees. */

import { faNum, formatFaDate, faLongDate } from "./format.js";
import { fontFaceCss, BODY_FONT_STACK } from "./fonts.js";

function esc(s) {
  return String(s == null ? "" : s)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
}

function prettySection(key) {
  if (!key) return "صفحه اصلی";
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(key).replace(/[-_]+/g, " ").trim();
  } catch (e) {
    return key;
  }
}

export function documentSlug(project) {
  const base = String(project?.site_name || project?.domain || "site")
    .replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .slice(0, 60)
    .trim();
  return base || "site-archive";
}

export function groupSections(pages) {
  const map = new Map();
  pages.forEach((p) => {
    const key = p.section || "";
    if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, { key, pages: [] });
    map.get(key).pages.push(p);
  });
  const sections = Array.from(map.values());
  sections.forEach((s) => {
    s.pages.sort((a, b) => (a.order_index ?? 0) - (b.order_index ?? 0));
    const withCat = s.pages.find((p) => p.category && p.category.trim());
    const label = withCat ? withCat.category.trim() : prettySection(s.key);
    s.label = label && label !== s.key ? label : prettySection(s.key);
    s.order = Math.min(...s.pages.map((p) => (typeof p.order_index === "number" ? p.order_index : 999999)));
  });
  sections.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
  return sections;
}

/* assign a global article number to every page, in site order */
export function numberSections(sections) {
  let n = 0;
  sections.forEach((s) => s.pages.forEach((p) => { n += 1; p.globalNumber = n; }));
}

/* Fill every part up to the page limit: 5000 pages with a 1000-page limit -> exactly 5 parts
   of 1000 (only the last part may be shorter). A section that does not fit is simply continued
   in the next part (labelled "ادامه"), so parts are never left half empty. */
export function partitionSections(sections, maxPagesPerPart = 1000) {
  const max = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxPagesPerPart) || 1000);
  const parts = [];
  let cur = null;
  for (const s of sections) {
    let i = 0;
    while (i < s.pages.length) {
      if (!cur || cur.pageCount >= max) {
        cur = { groups: [], pageCount: 0 };
        parts.push(cur);
      }
      const slice = s.pages.slice(i, i + (max - cur.pageCount));
      cur.groups.push({ label: i === 0 ? s.label : `${s.label} (ادامه)`, pages: slice });
      cur.pageCount += slice.length;
      i += slice.length;
    }
  }
  return parts;
}

function renderTable(table, inlineText) {
  const rows = [];
  table.querySelectorAll("tr").forEach((tr) => {
    const cells = [];
    tr.querySelectorAll("td,th").forEach((c) => {
      const t = inlineText(c).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      cells.push(`<${c.tagName.toLowerCase()}>${esc(t)}</${c.tagName.toLowerCase()}>`);
    });
    if (cells.length) rows.push(`<tr>${cells.join("")}</tr>`);
  });
  return rows.length ? `<table>${rows.join("")}</table>` : "";
}

/* render the extracted content as clean block-level HTML: headings, paragraphs,
   lists, blockquotes and tables (text only: no pictures). inline tags (strong/em/a) are flattened
   to their text so the reader sees plain readable text — never tag soup. */
export function renderArticleBody(contentHtml) {
  if (!contentHtml || !contentHtml.trim()) return "";
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(`<div id="__r">${contentHtml}</div>`, "text/html");
  const root = doc.getElementById("__r");
  if (!root) return "";

  const inlineText = (node) => {
    let s = "";
    node.childNodes.forEach((c) => {
      if (c.nodeType === 3) s += c.textContent || "";
      else if (c.nodeType === 1) {
        if (c.tagName === "BR") s += "\n";
        else s += inlineText(c);
      }
    });
    return s;
  };

  const out = [];
  function walk(node) {
    node.childNodes.forEach((child) => {
      if (child.nodeType === 3) {
        const t = (child.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
        if (t.trim()) out.push(`<p>${esc(t)}</p>`);
        return;
      }
      if (child.nodeType !== 1) return;
      const tag = child.tagName;

      if (tag === "IMG" || tag === "PICTURE" || tag === "SVG" || tag === "VIDEO" || tag === "AUDIO" || tag === "CANVAS") return;
      if (tag === "FIGURE") { walk(child); return; }
      if (tag === "BR") { out.push("<br/>"); return; }
      if (tag === "UL" || tag === "OL") {
        const items = [];
        child.querySelectorAll(":scope > li").forEach((li) => {
          const t = inlineText(li).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
          if (t) items.push(`<li>${esc(t)}</li>`);
        });
        if (items.length) out.push(`<${tag.toLowerCase()}>${items.join("")}</${tag.toLowerCase()}>`);
        return;
      }
      if (tag === "TABLE") { const t = renderTable(child, inlineText); if (t) out.push(t); return; }
      if (/^H[1-6]$/.test(tag)) {
        const t = inlineText(child).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (t) out.push(`<${tag.toLowerCase()}>${esc(t)}</${tag.toLowerCase()}>`);
        return;
      }
      if (tag === "P" || tag === "BLOCKQUOTE" || tag === "PRE") {
        const t = inlineText(child).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (t) out.push(`<${tag.toLowerCase()}>${esc(t)}</${tag.toLowerCase()}>`);
        return;
      }
      walk(child);
    });
  }
  walk(root);

  const body = out.join("").replace(/<(p|li|ul|ol|blockquote|h[1-6]|td|th|table)>/g, '<$1 dir="auto">');
  return body;
}

function articleHtml(page, number) {
  const meta = [];
  if (page.published_date) meta.push("تاریخ انتشار: " + formatFaDate(page.published_date));
  if (page.author) meta.push("نویسنده: " + esc(page.author));
  if (page.category) meta.push("دسته: " + esc(page.category));
  meta.push("کلمات: " + faNum(page.word_count || 0));

  const body = renderArticleBody(page.__content || "");
  const empty = !body.trim();
  const emptyNote = page.status === "failed"
    ? "استخراج این صفحه ناموفق بود" + (page.error ? ": " + esc(page.error) : "")
    : "این صفحه متن قابل‌استخراجی نداشت";

  return (
    `<article class="art">` +
    `<h2 id="a${number}" dir="auto"><span class="num">${faNum(number)}</span> ${esc(page.title || page.path || page.url)}</h2>` +
    `<p class="url"><a href="${esc(page.url)}">${esc(page.url)}</a></p>` +
    (meta.length ? `<p class="meta">${meta.join(" • ")}</p>` : "") +
    (page.description ? `<p class="desc" dir="auto">${esc(page.description)}</p>` : "") +
    (empty ? `<p class="empty">${emptyNote}</p>` : body) +
    `</article>`
  );
}

function styles() {
  return (
    fontFaceCss() +
    "body{font-family:" + BODY_FONT_STACK + ";direction:rtl;text-align:start;color:#12211f;line-height:1.95;font-size:11.5pt;margin:0;padding:28px 34px;background:#fff}" +
    "h1,h2,h3{line-height:1.6;color:#123f39}" +
    "p{margin:0 0 9pt}" +
    "a{color:#17625a;text-decoration:none}" +
    "blockquote{border-inline-start:3px solid #cbb894;padding:2px 12px;margin:10px 0;color:#3b4a47;background:#faf7f1}" +
    "table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin:10px 0}" +
    "td,th{border:1px solid #cfd6d4;padding:6px 8px;font-size:10.5pt}" +
    "ul,ol{margin:0 0 9pt;padding-inline-start:20px;padding-inline-end:0}" +
    "pre{background:#f4f6f6;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;direction:ltr;text-align:left;font-size:10pt;white-space:pre-wrap}" +
    ".cover{text-align:center;padding:50px 0 36px;border-bottom:2px solid #dcd3c2}" +
    ".cover h1{font-size:28pt;margin:0 0 8px}" +
    ".cover .src{font-size:11pt;color:#4d5c59;direction:ltr}" +
    ".cover .sub{color:#5d6b68;font-size:12pt;margin:2px 0}" +
    ".cover .fx{color:#17625a;font-weight:700}" +
    ".bism{font-size:22pt;color:#123f39;margin:0 0 4px}" +
    ".bism2{font-size:15pt;color:#4d5c59;margin:0 0 30px}" +
    ".toc{margin-top:26px;text-align:right}" +
    ".toc h2{font-size:16pt;border-bottom:1px solid #dcd3c2;padding-bottom:6px}" +
    ".toc ol{padding-right:22px}" +
    ".toc li{margin:4px 0;font-size:11pt}" +
    ".chapter{page-break-before:always;font-size:21pt;color:#123f39;border-bottom:2px solid #123f39;padding-bottom:8px;margin:0 0 18px}" +
    ".chapter small{display:block;font-size:10.5pt;color:#5d6b68;font-weight:400;margin-top:6px}" +
    ".art{margin:0 0 28px}" +
    ".art p,.art li,.art blockquote{text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-word}" +
    ".art h2{font-size:15pt;margin:22px 0 6px;page-break-after:avoid}" +
    ".art .num{display:inline-block;background:#123f39;color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:1px 10px;font-size:11pt;margin-left:6px}" +
    ".art .url{font-size:9.5pt;color:#7b8785;direction:ltr;text-align:left;word-break:break-all;margin:0 0 4px}" +
    ".art .meta{font-size:9.5pt;color:#5d6b68;margin:0 0 8px}" +
    ".art .desc{background:#f7f4ee;border-right:3px solid #cbb894;padding:8px 12px;font-size:11pt;color:#3b4a47}" +
    ".tocpage{page-break-before:always;page-break-after:always}.tocpage h2{font-size:18pt;border-bottom:2px solid #123f39}" +
    ".tocpage h3{margin:12px 0 4px;font-size:13pt}.tocpage ol{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}.tocpage li{margin:2px 0;font-size:10.5pt;text-align:start}" +
    ".empty{color:#8a9492;font-style:italic;font-size:10.5pt}" +
    "@page{size:A4;margin:16mm 14mm}" +
    "blockquote,pre,table{page-break-inside:avoid}"
  );
}

function wrapHtml(title, bodyInner) {
  return (
    `<!DOCTYPE html>` +
    `<html xmlns:o="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office" xmlns:w="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-html40" lang="fa" dir="rtl">` +
    `<head><meta charset="utf-8"/>` +
    `<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8"/>` +
    `<meta name="ProgId" content="Word.Document"/>` +
    `<title>${esc(title)}</title>` +
    `<style>${styles()}</style></head>` +
    `<body>${bodyInner}</body></html>`
  );
}

export function buildPartHtml({ project, parts, partIndex }) {
  const part = parts[partIndex];
  const partCount = parts.length;
  const siteName = project.site_name || project.domain || project.site_url;
  const generated = new Date().toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });

  const chapters = part.groups
    .map((g, gi) => {
      const head = `<h1 class="chapter" id="g${partIndex}_${gi}">${esc(g.label)}<small>${faNum(g.pages.length)} صفحه در این بخش</small></h1>`;
      const body = g.pages.map((p) => articleHtml(p, p.globalNumber)).join("");
      return head + body;
    })
    .join("");

  const downloaded = faLongDate(project.finished || project.created);
  const totalPages = parts.reduce((n, pp) => n + pp.pageCount, 0);
  let toc = "";
  if (partIndex === 0 && partCount > 1) {
    const items = parts
      .map((pp, i) => {
        const nums = pp.groups.flatMap((g) => g.pages).map((p) => p.globalNumber);
        const min = nums.length ? Math.min(...nums) : 0;
        const max = nums.length ? Math.max(...nums) : 0;
        return `<li>بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} — مقاله\u200cهای ${faNum(min)} تا ${faNum(max)} (${faNum(pp.pageCount)} صفحه)</li>`;
      })
      .join("");
    toc = `<div class="toc"><h2>فهرست بخش\u200cها</h2><ol>${items}</ol></div>`;
  }
  const cover =
    `<section class="cover">` +
    `<p class="bism">بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم</p>` +
    `<p class="bism2">الله مولانا و لا مولا لکم</p>` +
    `<h1>${esc(siteName)}</h1>` +
    `<p class="src">${esc(project.site_url)}</p>` +
    `<p class="sub">تاریخ دانلود: ${esc(downloaded)}</p>` +
    `<p class="sub">تعداد صفحات: ${faNum(totalPages)}</p>` +
    `<p class="sub fx">تهیه شده توسط اپ فراکسینتوم</p>` +
    (partCount > 1 ? `<p class="sub">بخش ${faNum(partIndex + 1)} از ${faNum(partCount)}</p>` : "") +
    toc +
    `</section>`;

  // clickable table of contents (internal links; works in the PDF viewer too)
  const tocPage =
    `<section class="tocpage"><h2>فهرست مطالب</h2>` +
    part.groups
      .map((g, gi) =>
        `<h3 dir="auto"><a href="#g${partIndex}_${gi}">${esc(g.label)}</a></h3><ol>` +
        g.pages.map((pg) => `<li dir="auto"><a href="#a${pg.globalNumber}">${faNum(pg.globalNumber)}. ${esc(String(pg.title || pg.path || pg.url).slice(0, 110))}</a></li>`).join("") +
        `</ol>`)
      .join("") +
    `</section>`;

  return wrapHtml(siteName, cover + tocPage + chapters);
}

export function buildSitemapXml(project, pages) {
  const rows = pages
    .map((p) => {
      const last = (p.published_date || "").slice(0, 10);
      return (
        "  <url>\n    <loc>" + esc(p.url) + "</loc>" +
        (last ? "\n    <lastmod>" + esc(last) + "</lastmod>" : "") +
        "\n    <priority>0.7</priority>\n  </url>"
      );
    })
    .join("\n");
  return (
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n' +
    '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">\n' +
    "  <!-- " + esc(project.site_url) + " — ساخته‌شده در " + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + " -->\n" +
    "  <!-- " + pages.length + " URLs -->\n" +
    rows +
    "\n</urlset>\n"
  );
}

function csvCell(v) {
  const s = String(v == null ? "" : v);
  return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
}

export function buildPagesCsv(pages) {
  const header = ["ردیف", "عنوان", "نشانی", "بخش", "دسته", "تاریخ انتشار", "نویسنده", "کلمات", "وضعیت"];
  const rows = pages.map((p, i) => [
    i + 1,
    p.title || "",
    p.url,
    p.section || "",
    p.category || "",
    p.published_date || "",
    p.author || "",
    p.word_count || 0,
    p.status === "extracted" ? "استخراج شد" : p.status === "failed" ? "ناموفق" : "در انتظار",
  ]);
  return "\uFEFF" + [header, ...rows].map((r) => r.map(csvCell).join(",")).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
}

export function downloadFile(content, filename, mime) {
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime + ";charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    a.remove();
  }, 3000);
}

#### FILE: src/docxBuilder.js ####
/* Real .docx (not HTML-in-disguise), built in the browser with the `docx` package.
   Persian/RTL: every paragraph is bidirectional and every run is right-to-left. */
import {
  Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, HeadingLevel, Table, TableRow, TableCell,
  WidthType, ExternalHyperlink, AlignmentType, Bookmark, InternalHyperlink, CharacterSet, LineRuleType,
} from "docx";
import JSZip from "jszip";
import { fontBytes, PERSIAN_FONT, LATIN_FONT } from "./fonts.js";
import { faNum, formatFaDate, faLongDate } from "./format.js";

/* Latin text -> Times New Roman, Persian/Arabic text -> the embedded Far.Nazanin font */
export const FONT = { ascii: LATIN_FONT, hAnsi: LATIN_FONT, eastAsia: LATIN_FONT, cs: PERSIAN_FONT };
const SIZE = 24; // half-points = 12pt

export function run(text, o = {}) {
  return new TextRun({
    text: String(text == null ? "" : text),
    font: FONT,
    rightToLeft: o.ltr ? false : o.rtl !== false,
    size: o.size || SIZE,
    sizeComplexScript: true,
    bold: !!o.bold,
    boldComplexScript: !!o.bold,
    italics: !!o.italics,
    color: o.color,
    language: o.ltr || o.rtl === false ? { value: "en-US" } : { value: "fa-IR", bidirectional: "fa-IR" },
  });
}

export function para(children, o = {}) {
  return new Paragraph({
    bidirectional: o.rtl !== false,
    spacing: { before: o.before ?? 0, after: o.after ?? 140, line: o.line ?? 360, lineRule: LineRuleType.AUTO },
    heading: o.heading,
    pageBreakBefore: !!o.pageBreakBefore,
    alignment: o.center ? AlignmentType.CENTER : o.justify ? AlignmentType.JUSTIFIED : undefined,
    indent: o.indent,
    keepNext: !!o.keepNext,
    children: Array.isArray(children) ? children : [children],
  });
}

const textPara = (t, o) => para(run(t, o), o);

/* direction follows the language of the text: Persian/Arabic -> right-to-left,
   English (and other Latin/Cyrillic/Greek) -> left-to-right */
const AR_RE = /[\u0590-\u08FF\uFB1D-\uFDFF\uFE70-\uFEFF]/g;
const LAT_RE = /[A-Za-z\u00C0-\u024F\u0370-\u03FF\u0400-\u04FF]/g;
export function detectRtl(text, fallback = true) {
  const t = String(text || "");
  const a = (t.match(AR_RE) || []).length;
  const l = (t.match(LAT_RE) || []).length;
  if (!a && !l) return fallback;
  return a >= l;
}

function cleanText(node) {
  let s = "";
  node.childNodes.forEach((c) => {
    if (c.nodeType === 3) s += c.textContent || "";
    else if (c.nodeType === 1) s += c.tagName === "BR" ? "\n" : cleanText(c);
  });
  return s.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

/* ---------- article HTML -> docx blocks ---------- */
function tableBlock(tableEl, def) {
  const rows = [];
  let cols = 0;
  tableEl.querySelectorAll("tr").forEach((tr) => {
    const cells = [];
    tr.querySelectorAll("td,th").forEach((c) => cells.push({ t: cleanText(c), head: c.tagName === "TH" }));
    if (cells.length) { rows.push(cells); cols = Math.max(cols, cells.length); }
  });
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  const tableRtl = detectRtl(rows.map((r) => r.map((c) => c.t).join(" ")).join(" "), def);
  const total = 9000;
  const w = Math.floor(total / cols);
  return new Table({
    width: { size: total, type: WidthType.DXA },
    columnWidths: Array(cols).fill(w),
    visuallyRightToLeft: tableRtl,
    rows: rows.map((cells) =>
      new TableRow({
        children: Array.from({ length: cols }, (_v, i) => {
          const c = cells[i] || { t: "", head: false };
          return new TableCell({
            width: { size: w, type: WidthType.DXA },
            children: [para(run(c.t, { size: 21, bold: c.head, rtl: tableRtl }), { after: 40, line: 300, rtl: tableRtl })],
          });
        }),
      }),
    ),
  });
}

async function bodyBlocks(contentHtml) {
  if (!contentHtml || !contentHtml.trim()) return [];
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(`<div id="__r">${contentHtml}</div>`, "text/html");
  const root = doc.getElementById("__r");
  if (!root) return [];
  const def = detectRtl(cleanText(root), true);

  const out = [];

  const walk = async (node) => {
    for (const child of Array.from(node.childNodes)) {
      if (child.nodeType === 3) {
        const t = (child.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (t) out.push(textPara(t, { justify: true, rtl: detectRtl(t, def) }));
        continue;
      }
      if (child.nodeType !== 1) continue;
      const tag = child.tagName;
      if (tag === "IMG" || tag === "PICTURE" || tag === "SVG" || tag === "VIDEO" || tag === "AUDIO" || tag === "CANVAS") continue; // text only
      if (tag === "FIGURE") { await walk(child); continue; }
      if (tag === "UL" || tag === "OL") {
        let n = 0;
        child.querySelectorAll(":scope > li").forEach((li) => {
          const t = cleanText(li);
          if (!t) return;
          n += 1;
          const mark = tag === "OL" ? `${faNum(n)}. ` : "• ";
          const r = detectRtl(t, def);
          out.push(para(run(mark + t, { rtl: r }), { indent: { start: 360 }, after: 80, justify: true, rtl: r }));
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (tag === "TABLE") { const t = tableBlock(child, def); if (t) out.push(t); continue; }
      if (/^H[1-6]$/.test(tag)) {
        const t = cleanText(child);
        if (t) { const r = detectRtl(t, def); out.push(para(run(t, { bold: true, size: 26, color: "123F39", rtl: r }), { keepNext: true, after: 100, rtl: r })); }
        continue;
      }
      if (tag === "BLOCKQUOTE") {
        const t = cleanText(child);
        if (t) { const r = detectRtl(t, def); out.push(para(run(t, { italics: true, color: "3B4A47", rtl: r }), { indent: { start: 480 }, justify: true, rtl: r })); }
        continue;
      }
      if (tag === "P" || tag === "PRE") {
        const t = cleanText(child);
        if (t) out.push(textPara(t, { justify: true, rtl: detectRtl(t, def) }));
        continue;
      }
      await walk(child);
    }
  };
  await walk(root);
  return out;
}

async function articleBlocks(page, number) {
  const title = page.title || page.path || page.url;
  const pageRtl = detectRtl((page.__content || "").replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " "), true);
  const titleRtl = detectRtl(title, pageRtl);
  const blocks = [
    para([new Bookmark({ id: `a${number}`, children: [run(`${faNum(number)}. ${title}`, { bold: true, size: 32, color: "123F39", rtl: titleRtl })] })], { heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, keepNext: true, after: 80, rtl: titleRtl }),
    para(
      new ExternalHyperlink({
        link: page.url,
        children: [new TextRun({ text: page.url, font: FONT, size: 18, color: "17625A", style: "Hyperlink" })],
      }),
      { after: 60, line: 260, rtl: false },
    ),
  ];
  const meta = [];
  if (page.published_date) meta.push("تاریخ انتشار: " + formatFaDate(page.published_date));
  if (page.author) meta.push("نویسنده: " + page.author);
  if (page.category) meta.push("دسته: " + page.category);
  meta.push("کلمات: " + faNum(page.word_count || 0));
  blocks.push(para(run(meta.join("  •  "), { size: 19, color: "5D6B68" }), { after: 100 }));
  if (page.description) { const dr = detectRtl(page.description, pageRtl); blocks.push(para(run(page.description, { color: "3B4A47", italics: true, rtl: dr }), { indent: { start: 240 }, rtl: dr })); }

  const body = await bodyBlocks(page.__content || "");
  if (body.length) blocks.push(...body);
  else {
    const note = page.status === "failed"
      ? "استخراج این صفحه ناموفق بود" + (page.error ? ": " + page.error : "")
      : "این صفحه متن قابل‌استخراجی نداشت";
    blocks.push(para(run(note, { italics: true, color: "8A9492", size: 21 })));
  }
  return blocks;
}

/* ---------- whole part -> Blob ---------- */
export async function buildDocxBlob({ project, parts, partIndex, onProgress }) {
  const part = parts[partIndex];
  const siteName = project.site_name || project.domain || project.site_url;
  const downloaded = faLongDate(project.finished || project.created);
  const totalPages = parts.reduce((n, pp) => n + pp.pageCount, 0);

  const children = [
    para(run("بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم", { bold: true, size: 44, color: "123F39" }), { center: true, before: 500, after: 60 }),
    para(run("الله مولانا و لا مولا لکم", { size: 30, color: "4D5C59" }), { center: true, after: 520 }),
    para(run(siteName, { bold: true, size: 56, color: "123F39", rtl: detectRtl(siteName, true) }), { center: true, after: 160, rtl: detectRtl(siteName, true) }),
    para(run(project.site_url, { ltr: true, size: 22, color: "4D5C59" }), { center: true, rtl: false }),
    para(run("تاریخ دانلود: " + downloaded, { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
    para(run("تعداد صفحات: " + faNum(totalPages), { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
    para(run("تهیه شده توسط اپ فراکسینتوم", { bold: true, size: 26, color: "17625A" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
  ];
  if (parts.length > 1) {
    children.push(para(run(`بخش ${faNum(partIndex + 1)} از ${faNum(parts.length)}`, { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true }));
  }

  if (partIndex === 0 && parts.length > 1) {
    children.push(para(run("فهرست بخش‌ها", { bold: true, size: 30 }), { heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, after: 100 }));
    parts.forEach((pp, i) => {
      const nums = pp.groups.flatMap((g) => g.pages).map((p) => p.globalNumber);
      const lo = nums.length ? Math.min(...nums) : 0;
      const hi = nums.length ? Math.max(...nums) : 0;
      children.push(textPara(`بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} — مقاله‌های ${faNum(lo)} تا ${faNum(hi)} (${faNum(pp.pageCount)} صفحه)`, { after: 60 }));
    });
  }

  // clickable table of contents (internal links to the bookmarks above each chapter / article)
  children.push(para(run("فهرست مطالب", { bold: true, size: 36, color: "123F39" }), { pageBreakBefore: true, after: 160 }));
  part.groups.forEach((g, gi) => {
    const gr = detectRtl(g.label, true);
    children.push(para(new InternalHyperlink({ anchor: `g${partIndex}_${gi}`, children: [run(g.label, { bold: true, size: 26, color: "17625A", rtl: gr })] }), { after: 60, keepNext: true, rtl: gr }));
    g.pages.forEach((pg) => {
      const t = `${faNum(pg.globalNumber)}. ${String(pg.title || pg.path || pg.url).slice(0, 110)}`;
      const r = detectRtl(t, true);
      children.push(para(new InternalHyperlink({ anchor: `a${pg.globalNumber}`, children: [run(t, { size: 21, color: "17625A", rtl: r })] }), { indent: { start: 360 }, after: 30, line: 300, rtl: r }));
    });
  });

  const total = part.groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.pages.length, 0);
  let done = 0;
  for (const [gi, g] of part.groups.entries()) {
    children.push(
      para([new Bookmark({ id: `g${partIndex}_${gi}`, children: [run(g.label, { bold: true, size: 44, color: "123F39", rtl: detectRtl(g.label, true) })] })], { heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, pageBreakBefore: true, after: 60, rtl: detectRtl(g.label, true) }),
      para(run(`${faNum(g.pages.length)} صفحه در این بخش`, { size: 21, color: "5D6B68" })),
    );
    for (const p of g.pages) {
      children.push(...(await articleBlocks(p, p.globalNumber)));
      done += 1;
      if (done % 5 === 0) {
        onProgress?.(done, total);
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); // let the UI breathe on phones
      }
    }
  }
  onProgress?.(total, total);

  const doc = new Document({
    creator: "آرشیوساز",
    title: siteName,
    fonts: [{ name: PERSIAN_FONT, data: fontBytes(), characterSet: CharacterSet.ARABIC }],
    styles: { default: { document: { run: { font: FONT, size: SIZE } } } },
    sections: [{
      properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 1134, bottom: 1134, left: 1134, right: 1134 } } },
      children,
    }],
  });
  const blob = await fixEmbeddedFont(await Packer.toBlob(doc));
  return { blob };
}

/* The docx library stores an embedded font whose name contains a dot ("Far.Nazanin") as
   "fonts/Far.odttf" but points the relationship at "fonts/Far.Nazanin.odttf" -> a broken package.
   Rename the part so that the relationship resolves. */
export async function fixEmbeddedFont(blob) {
  const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(blob);
  const rels = await zip.file("word/_rels/fontTable.xml.rels")?.async("string");
  const m = rels && /Target="fonts\/([^"]+)"/.exec(rels);
  if (!m) return blob;
  const want = "word/fonts/" + m[1];
  if (!zip.file(want)) {
    const cand = Object.keys(zip.files).find((n) => /^word\/fonts\/[^/]+\.odttf$/.test(n));
    if (cand) {
      zip.file(want, await zip.file(cand).async("uint8array"));
      zip.remove(cand);
    }
  }
  // same flag Word itself writes when "Embed fonts in the file" is on (placed in schema order)
  const st = await zip.file("word/settings.xml")?.async("string");
  if (st && !st.includes("embedTrueTypeFonts")) {
    zip.file("word/settings.xml", st.includes("<w:displayBackgroundShape/>")
      ? st.replace("<w:displayBackgroundShape/>", "<w:displayBackgroundShape/><w:embedTrueTypeFonts/>")
      : st.replace(/(<w:settings[^>]*>)/, "$1<w:embedTrueTypeFonts/>"));
  }
  return zip.generateAsync({ type: "blob", mimeType: blob.type, compression: "DEFLATE" });
}

export function downloadBlob(blob, filename) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }, 5000);
}

/* EPUB 3 output (with an EPUB 2 NCX for old readers): clickable contents, embedded Persian font. */
import JSZip from "jszip";
import { fontBytes } from "./fonts.js";
import { renderArticleBody } from "./documentBuilder.js";
import { detectRtl } from "./docxBuilder.js";
import { when, monthOf, notes } from "./tgExport.js";
import { faNum, faLongDate, formatFaDate } from "./format.js";

const esc = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));

const CSS = `@font-face{font-family:'FxPersian';src:url(fonts/persian.ttf);font-weight:normal;font-style:normal}
body{font-family:'FxPersian','Times New Roman',serif;line-height:1.8;margin:0 4%}
p,li,blockquote{text-align:justify;margin:0 0 .7em}
h1,h2,h3{line-height:1.5;color:#123f39}
h1{font-size:1.5em;border-bottom:2px solid #123f39}
.url{direction:ltr;text-align:left;font-size:.75em;color:#777;word-break:break-all}
.meta,.note{font-size:.8em;color:#666}
.cover{text-align:center;margin-top:20%}
.bism{font-size:1.6em;color:#123f39}.fx{color:#17625a;font-weight:bold}
blockquote{border-inline-start:3px solid #cbb894;padding:.2em .8em}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}td,th{border:1px solid #bbb;padding:3px 6px}`;

/* HTML string -> well-formed XHTML fragment */
function toXhtml(html) {
  const d = new DOMParser().parseFromString(`<div>${html}</div>`, "text/html");
  return new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(d.body.firstChild).replace(/ xmlns="http:\/\/www\.w3\.org\/1999\/xhtml"/, "");
}

function pageDoc(title, lang, rtl, body) {
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:epub="http://www.idpf.org/2007/ops" lang="${lang}" xml:lang="${lang}" dir="${rtl ? "rtl" : "ltr"}">` +
    `<head><meta charset="utf-8"/><title>${esc(title)}</title><link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="style.css"/></head><body>${body}</body></html>`;
}

/* chapters: [{ file, title, body, nav: 0|1 (1 = nested under the previous nav 0 entry) }] */
async function makeEpub({ title, lang, rtl, chapters }) {
  const zip = new JSZip();
  zip.file("mimetype", "application/epub+zip", { compression: "STORE" });
  zip.file("META-INF/container.xml", `<?xml version="1.0"?><container version="1.0" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:container"><rootfiles><rootfile full-path="OEBPS/content.opf" media-type="application/oebps-package+xml"/></rootfiles></container>`);
  zip.file("OEBPS/style.css", CSS);
  zip.file("OEBPS/fonts/persian.ttf", fontBytes());
  chapters.forEach((c) => zip.file("OEBPS/" + c.file, pageDoc(c.title, lang, rtl, c.body)));

  const id = "urn:uuid:" + crypto.randomUUID();
  const items = [
    `<item id="nav" href="nav.xhtml" media-type="application/xhtml+xml" properties="nav"/>`,
    `<item id="ncx" href="toc.ncx" media-type="application/x-dtbncx+xml"/>`,
    `<item id="css" href="style.css" media-type="text/css"/>`,
    `<item id="font" href="fonts/persian.ttf" media-type="font/ttf"/>`,
    ...chapters.map((c, i) => `<item id="c${i}" href="${c.file}" media-type="application/xhtml+xml"/>`),
  ].join("");
  zip.file("OEBPS/content.opf",
    `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><package xmlns="http://www.idpf.org/2007/opf" version="3.0" unique-identifier="uid" xml:lang="${lang}">` +
    `<metadata xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:identifier id="uid">${id}</dc:identifier><dc:title>${esc(title)}</dc:title><dc:language>${lang}</dc:language><dc:creator>FRAXINETUM</dc:creator>` +
    `<meta property="dcterms:modified">${new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d+Z$/, "Z")}</meta></metadata>` +
    `<manifest>${items}</manifest><spine toc="ncx" page-progression-direction="${rtl ? "rtl" : "ltr"}">${chapters.map((_c, i) => `<itemref idref="c${i}"/>`).join("")}</spine></package>`);

  // navigation (EPUB 3) + NCX (EPUB 2)
  const navEntries = chapters.map((c, i) => ({ c, i })).filter((x) => x.c.nav !== undefined);
  const tops = [];
  navEntries.forEach(({ c }) => { if (c.nav === 0 || !tops.length) tops.push({ c, kids: [] }); else tops[tops.length - 1].kids.push(c); });
  const navHtml = tops.map((t) =>
    `<li><a href="${t.c.file}">${esc(t.c.title)}</a>` +
    (t.kids.length ? `<ol>${t.kids.map((k) => `<li><a href="${k.file}">${esc(k.title)}</a></li>`).join("")}</ol>` : "") + `</li>`).join("");
  zip.file("OEBPS/nav.xhtml", pageDoc("فهرست", lang, rtl, `<nav epub:type="toc" id="toc"><h1>${rtl ? "فهرست مطالب" : "Contents"}</h1><ol>${navHtml}</ol></nav>`));
  let order = 0;
  zip.file("OEBPS/toc.ncx",
    `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><ncx xmlns="http://www.daisy.org/z3986/2005/ncx/" version="2005-1"><head><meta name="dtb:uid" content="${id}"/></head><docTitle><text>${esc(title)}</text></docTitle><navMap>` +
    navEntries.map(({ c }) => `<navPoint id="n${order}" playOrder="${++order}"><navLabel><text>${esc(c.title)}</text></navLabel><content src="${c.file}"/></navPoint>`).join("") +
    `</navMap></ncx>`);

  return zip.generateAsync({ type: "blob", mimeType: "application/epub+zip", compression: "DEFLATE", compressionOptions: { level: 6 } });
}

const coverBody = (project, name, total, label, extra) =>
  `<div class="cover"><p class="bism">بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم</p><p>الله مولانا و لا مولا لکم</p><h1 dir="auto">${esc(name)}</h1>` +
  `<p class="url">${esc(project.site_url)}</p><p>تاریخ دانلود: ${esc(faLongDate(project.finished || project.created))}</p>` +
  `<p>${label}: ${faNum(total)}</p><p class="fx">تهیه شده توسط اپ فراکسینتوم</p>${extra || ""}</div>`;

/* ---------------- website ---------------- */
export async function buildSiteEpub({ project, parts, partIndex, onProgress }) {
  const part = parts[partIndex];
  const name = project.site_name || project.domain || project.site_url;
  const sample = part.groups.flatMap((g) => g.pages).slice(0, 25).map((p) => p.title || "").join(" ");
  const rtl = detectRtl(sample, true);
  const total = parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.pageCount, 0);
  const chapters = [{ file: "cover.xhtml", title: name, nav: 0, body: coverBody(project, name, total, "تعداد صفحات", parts.length > 1 ? `<p>بخش ${faNum(partIndex + 1)} از ${faNum(parts.length)}</p>` : "") }];
  let done = 0;
  const all = part.groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.pages.length, 0);

  for (const [gi, g] of part.groups.entries()) {
    chapters.push({ file: `g${gi}.xhtml`, title: g.label, nav: 0, body: `<h1 dir="auto">${esc(g.label)}</h1><p class="note">${faNum(g.pages.length)} صفحه</p>` });
    for (const p of g.pages) {
      const num = p.globalNumber;
      const bodyHtml = renderArticleBody(p.__content || "");
      const meta = [];
      if (p.published_date) meta.push("تاریخ انتشار: " + formatFaDate(p.published_date));
      if (p.author) meta.push("نویسنده: " + p.author);
      if (p.category) meta.push("دسته: " + p.category);
      const title = p.title || p.path || p.url;
      const body = `<h2 dir="auto">${faNum(num)}. ${esc(title)}</h2><p class="url">${esc(p.url)}</p>` +
        (meta.length ? `<p class="meta">${esc(meta.join(" • "))}</p>` : "") +
        (bodyHtml.trim() ? toXhtml(bodyHtml) : `<p class="note">${p.status === "failed" ? "استخراج این صفحه ناموفق بود." : "این صفحه متن قابل‌استخراجی نداشت."}</p>`);
      chapters.push({ file: `a${num}.xhtml`, title: `${faNum(num)}. ${String(title).slice(0, 120)}`, nav: 1, body });
      done += 1;
      if (done % 5 === 0) { onProgress?.(done, all); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); }
    }
  }
  return makeEpub({ title: name, lang: rtl ? "fa" : "en", rtl, chapters });
}

/* ---------------- Telegram channel ---------------- */
export async function buildTgEpub({ project, parts, partIndex, onProgress }) {
  const part = parts[partIndex];
  const name = project.site_name || project.tg_user;
  const rtl = detectRtl(part.msgs.slice(0, 30).map((m) => m.text).join(" "), true);
  const total = parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.msgs.length, 0);
  const chapters = [{ file: "cover.xhtml", title: name, nav: 0, body: coverBody(project, name, total, "تعداد پیام‌ها", parts.length > 1 ? `<p>بخش ${faNum(partIndex + 1)} از ${faNum(parts.length)}</p>` : "") }];
  let cur = null, curMonth = "", count = 0, ci = 0, done = 0;
  const flushCh = () => { if (cur) chapters.push(cur); cur = null; };

  for (const m of part.msgs) {
    const mo = monthOf(m.date);
    if (!cur || mo !== curMonth || count >= 100) {
      const first = mo !== curMonth;
      flushCh();
      curMonth = mo; count = 0; ci += 1;
      cur = { file: `m${ci}.xhtml`, title: first ? mo : `${mo} (${faNum(ci)})`, nav: first ? 0 : 1, body: `<h1 dir="auto">${esc(mo)}</h1>` };
    }
    count += 1;
    let h = `<p class="meta">#${faNum(m.msg_id)} • ${esc(when(m.date))}${m.fwd ? " • ارسال‌شده از: " + esc(m.fwd) : ""}</p>`;
    String(m.text || "").split("\n").forEach((line) => { if (line.trim()) h += `<p dir="auto">${esc(line.trim())}</p>`; });
    notes(m).forEach((n) => { h += `<p class="note">${esc(n)}</p>`; });
    if (m.link && (m.link.title || m.link.url)) h += `<p dir="auto"><b>${esc(m.link.title)}</b><br/><span class="url">${esc(m.link.url)}</span></p>`;
    cur.body += h + `<hr/>`;
    done += 1;
    if (done % 20 === 0) { onProgress?.(done, part.msgs.length); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); }
  }
  flushCh();
  return makeEpub({ title: name, lang: rtl ? "fa" : "en", rtl, chapters });
}

import { Capacitor, registerPlugin } from "@capacitor/core";
import { Filesystem, Directory } from "@capacitor/filesystem";
import { Share } from "@capacitor/share";

const PrintHtml = registerPlugin("PrintHtml"); // Android: save into Download/FRAXINETUM, HTML -> PDF, open a file

export const MIME = {
  docx: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
  pdf: "application/pdf", epub: "application/epub+zip", csv: "text/csv", xml: "application/xml", txt: "text/plain",
};

export const isNative = () => Capacitor.isNativePlatform();

function blobToBase64(blob) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = () => resolve(String(r.result).split(",")[1] || "");
    r.onerror = () => reject(r.error);
    r.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

function failure(r, fallback) {
  if (r && r.needsPermission) return new Error("اجازهٔ ذخیره‌سازی داده نشد. اجازه را بدهید و دوباره بزنید.");
  return new Error(fallback + (r && r.error ? ` (${r.error})` : ""));
}

/* Android: the file goes STRAIGHT into Download/FRAXINETUM (no share sheet).
   Browser: normal download.  Returns { where, uri, size }. */
export async function saveBlobToDownloads(blob, filename) {
  if (isNative()) {
    const ext = (filename.split(".").pop() || "bin").toLowerCase();
    const tmp = `fx-${Date.now()}.${ext}`; // plain ASCII name inside the app cache
    const data = await blobToBase64(blob);
    await Filesystem.writeFile({ path: tmp, data, directory: Directory.Cache });
    const { uri } = await Filesystem.getUri({ path: tmp, directory: Directory.Cache });
    const r = await PrintHtml.saveFile({
      path: decodeURIComponent(uri.replace(/^file:\/\//, "")),
      filename, mime: MIME[ext] || "application/octet-stream",
    });
    if (!r || !r.saved) throw failure(r, "ذخیره در پوشهٔ Download ناموفق بود.");
    return { where: r.location, uri: r.uri || "", size: blob.size };
  }
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }, 4000);
  return { where: "", uri: "", size: blob.size };
}

export function saveTextToDownloads(text, filename, mime) {
  return saveBlobToDownloads(new Blob([text], { type: mime + ";charset=utf-8" }), filename);
}

/* PDF: Android writes the file itself (no print dialog) straight into Download/FRAXINETUM */
export async function savePdfToDownloads(html, filename) {
  if (isNative()) {
    const r = await PrintHtml.toPdf({ html, filename });
    if (!r || !r.saved) throw failure(r, "ساخت یا ذخیرهٔ PDF ناموفق بود.");
    return { where: r.location, uri: r.uri || "", size: r.size || 0 };
  }
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: "text/html;charset=utf-8" }));
  window.open(url, "_blank");
  return { where: "", uri: "", size: html.length };
}

/* used by the «دانلودها» page (user-initiated) */
export async function openSaved(uri, mime) {
  if (!isNative() || !uri) throw new Error("باز کردن فایل فقط روی گوشی ممکن است.");
  await PrintHtml.openFile({ uri, mime });
}

export async function shareSaved(uri, name) {
  if (!isNative() || !uri) throw new Error("اشتراک‌گذاری فقط روی گوشی ممکن است.");
  await Share.share({ title: name, url: uri, dialogTitle: "ارسال فایل" });
}

#### FILE: src/downloads.js ####
/* One place that runs every export: shows an Android notification (progress -> «دانلود انجام شد»),
   saves the file into Download/FRAXINETUM, remembers it for the «دانلودها» page and fires an
   in-app toast. */
import { registerPlugin } from "@capacitor/core";
import * as store from "./store.js";
import { getSettings } from "./settings.js";
import { isNative, saveBlobToDownloads, saveTextToDownloads, savePdfToDownloads } from "./export.js";

const Notify = registerPlugin("Notify");
let toastFn = () => {};
let seq = 1000;

export function setToast(fn) { toastFn = fn; }

const wants = () => isNative() && getSettings().notify !== false;
const safe = async (p) => { try { await p; } catch (_e) { /* notification is optional */ } };

/* make(progress) -> { blob } | { html } (PDF) | { text, mime }  */
export async function runDownload({ name, mime, project, label, make }) {
  const id = (seq += 1);
  const what = label || name;
  if (wants()) await safe(Notify.begin({ id, text: `در حال ساخت «${what}»…` }));
  let last = 0;
  const progress = (n, total) => {
    if (!wants() || !total || Date.now() - last < 1500) return;
    last = Date.now();
    safe(Notify.progress({ id, text: `در حال ساخت «${what}»…`, percent: Math.round((n / total) * 100) }));
  };
  try {
    const made = await make(progress);
    let saved;
    if (made.html != null) saved = await savePdfToDownloads(made.html, name);
    else if (made.text != null) saved = await saveTextToDownloads(made.text, name, made.mime || mime);
    else saved = await saveBlobToDownloads(made.blob, name);
    const rec = {
      id: `d${Date.now()}-${seq}`, name, mime, size: saved.size || 0, created: Date.now(),
      where: saved.where || "", uri: saved.uri || "",
      project_id: (project && project.id) || "", project_name: (project && (project.site_name || project.domain)) || "",
    };
    await store.addDownload(rec);
    if (wants()) await safe(Notify.done({ id, title: "دانلود انجام شد", text: name, uri: rec.uri, mime }));
    toastFn({ title: "دانلود انجام شد", text: name + (rec.where ? ` — ${rec.where}` : ""), kind: "ok", action: "downloads" });
    return rec;
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = String((e && e.message) || e);
    if (wants()) await safe(Notify.fail({ id, text: msg.slice(0, 120) }));
    toastFn({ title: "دانلود ناموفق بود", text: msg, kind: "err" });
    throw e;
  }
}

/* Pages reached from the side menu + the menu itself. Pure HTML builders. */
import { faNum, faLongDate } from "./format.js";
import { getSettings, ACCENTS } from "./settings.js";

export const esc = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));

export const MENU = [
  { v: "home", ic: "⌂", t: "صفحهٔ اصلی" },
  { v: "contact", ic: "✉", t: "ارتباط با ما" },
  { v: "downloads", ic: "⬇", t: "دانلودها" },
  { v: "about", ic: "ⓘ", t: "دربارهٔ برنامه" },
  { v: "settings", ic: "⚙", t: "تنظیمات" },
  { v: "storage", ic: "▤", t: "حافظه و پروژه‌ها", sep: true },
  { v: "updates", ic: "⟳", t: "به‌روزرسانی و پس‌زمینه" },
  { v: "privacy", ic: "⚖", t: "حریم خصوصی و نکات حقوقی" },
];

export const PAGE_TITLES = Object.fromEntries(MENU.map((m) => [m.v, m.t]));

export function drawerHtml(current, logoUrl) {
  return `<div class="scrim" data-act="closemenu"></div>
  <nav class="drawer" aria-label="منو">
    <div class="dh"><img class="logo" src="${logoUrl}" alt="" /><div><h1 style="font-size:calc(18px*var(--fs))">FRAXINETUM</h1><div class="sub">نسخهٔ ${faNum(BUILD)}</div></div></div>
    ${MENU.map((m) => `<button class="mi${m.v === current ? " on" : ""}${m.sep ? " sep" : ""}" data-act="nav" data-v="${m.v}"><span class="ic">${m.ic}</span>${m.t}</button>`).join("")}
  </nav>`;
}

/* ---------------- downloads ---------------- */
const KIND = { docx: "WORD", pdf: "PDF", epub: "EPUB", csv: "CSV", xml: "XML" };
const human = (n) => {
  if (!n) return "";
  if (n < 1024) return faNum(n) + " بایت";
  if (n < 1048576) return faNum(Math.round(n / 1024)) + " کیلوبایت";
  return faNum((n / 1048576).toFixed(1)) + " مگابایت";
};

export function downloadsHtml(list, native) {
  if (!list.length) {
    return `<div class="card"><h2>دانلودها</h2><p class="mut">هنوز خروجی‌ای ذخیره نشده است. هر فایل Word، PDF، EPUB، CSV یا XML که بسازید، به‌صورت خودکار با تاریخ در همین صفحه نشان داده می‌شود.</p></div>`;
  }
  let lastDay = "";
  const rows = list.map((d) => {
    const day = faLongDate(d.created);
    const head = day !== lastDay ? `<div class="date-h">${esc(day)}</div>` : "";
    lastDay = day;
    const ext = (d.name.split(".").pop() || "").toLowerCase();
    const time = new Date(d.created).toLocaleTimeString("fa-IR", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
    return head + `<div class="card" style="padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:8px"><div class="dl">
      <div class="badge">${KIND[ext] || ext.toUpperCase()}</div>
      <div class="grow" style="min-width:0">
        <div class="nm">${esc(d.name)}</div>
        <div class="mut">${esc(time)}${d.size ? " — " + human(d.size) : ""}${d.project_name ? " — " + esc(d.project_name) : ""}</div>
        ${d.where ? `<div class="mut ltr">${esc(d.where)}</div>` : ""}
        <div class="row" style="margin-top:8px">
          ${native && d.uri ? `<button data-act="dl-open" data-id="${d.id}">باز کردن</button><button class="sec" data-act="dl-share" data-id="${d.id}">اشتراک‌گذاری</button>` : ""}
          <button class="dan" data-act="dl-del" data-id="${d.id}">حذف از فهرست</button>
        </div>
      </div></div></div>`;
  }).join("");
  return `<div class="card"><h2>دانلودها</h2><p class="mut">خروجی‌های ذخیره‌شده، از جدید به قدیم و به‌ترتیب تاریخ. فایل‌ها در پوشهٔ Download/FRAXINETUM گوشی هستند؛ «حذف از فهرست» فقط ردیف را از این صفحه برمی‌دارد، نه خود فایل را.</p></div>${rows}`;
}

    ? `<p>فضای مصرف‌شدهٔ برنامه: <b>${mb(est.usage)} مگابایت</b>${est.quota ? ` از حدود ${mb(est.quota)} مگابایت` : ""}</p>`

    ? projects.map((p) => `<div class="row between" style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)"><div class="grow" style="min-width:0"><div class="title">${esc(p.site_name || p.domain)}</div><div class="mut">${p.kind === "tg" ? `${faNum(p.tg_count || 0)} پیام` : `${faNum(p.extracted || 0)} صفحه`}</div></div><button class="dan" data-act="del" data-id="${p.id}">حذف</button></div>`).join("")
    : `<p class="mut">پروژه‌ای ذخیره نشده است.</p>`;
  return `<div class="card"><h2>حافظه و پروژه‌ها</h2>${usage}
  <div class="note">متن‌های آرشیو فقط روی همین گوشی است. اگر داده‌های برنامه را از تنظیمات اندروید پاک کنید یا برنامه را حذف کنید، پروژه‌ها از بین می‌روند؛ فایل‌های ساخته‌شده در پوشهٔ Download می‌مانند.</div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3 style="margin-top:0">پروژه‌ها</h3>${rows}</div>
  <div class="card"><h3 style="margin-top:0">سابقهٔ دانلودها</h3><button class="sec" data-act="dl-clear">پاک کردن سابقهٔ فهرست دانلودها</button><div class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">فایل‌های داخل پوشهٔ Download پاک نمی‌شوند.</div></div>`;
