    <li>فراکسینتوم سروری ندارد و هیچ داده‌ای برای ما ارسال نمی‌شود. متن‌ها، پروژه‌ها و تنظیمات فقط روی همین گوشی می‌مانند.</li>
    <li>برنامه فقط به سایت یا کانالی که خودتان وارد می‌کنید درخواست می‌فرستد، و برای بررسی نسخهٔ جدید به GitHub. درخواست‌ها را مثل مرورگر موبایل خود گوشی ارسال می‌کند.</li>
    <li>با حذف پروژه یا پاک کردن داده‌های برنامه، آرشیو پاک می‌شود. فایل‌های داخل پوشهٔ Download را خودتان مدیریت می‌کنید.</li>
  </ul>
  <h3>نکات حقوقی</h3>
  <ul class="fx">
    <li>محتوای سایت‌ها و کانال‌ها معمولاً حق کپی‌رایت دارد. این برنامه برای آرشیو و مطالعهٔ شخصی است؛ بازنشر یا فروش نیاز به اجازهٔ صاحب اثر دارد.</li>
    <li>شرایط استفادهٔ هر سایت را رعایت کنید. برنامه به‌طور پیش‌فرض robots.txt را رعایت می‌کند و بین درخواست‌ها فاصله می‌اندازد؛ خاموش کردنشان مسئولیت خود شماست.</li>
    <li>مسئولیت استفاده از برنامه و محتوای دانلودشده با کاربر است.</li>
  </ul></div>`;
}

#### FILE: src/update.js ####
/* In-app update check. Every build is numbered with the GitHub run number; the app
   asks GitHub for the newest successful build of this repo and, if it is newer,
   opens the direct APK link (Android installs it over the old version and keeps
   all saved data, because every build is signed with the same key). */
import { Browser } from "@capacitor/browser";

export const BUILD = typeof __BUILD__ !== "undefined" ? __BUILD__ : 0;
export const REPO = typeof __REPO__ !== "undefined" ? __REPO__ : "";

export function apkUrl() {
  return `https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/FRAXINETUM.apk`;
}

export async function checkUpdate() {
  if (!REPO) return { ok: false, error: "نسخهٔ آزمایشی؛ آدرس مخزن مشخص نیست." };
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/actions/runs?status=success&per_page=1`, {
      headers: { Accept: "application/vnd.github+json" },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: "پاسخ GitHub: " + res.status + " (مخزن باید عمومی باشد)" };
    const j = await res.json();
    const latest = Number(j.workflow_runs?.[0]?.run_number || 0);
    return { ok: true, latest, available: latest > BUILD };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: "بررسی انجام نشد: " + String((e && e.message) || e) };
  }
}

export async function downloadUpdate() {
  await Browser.open({ url: apkUrl() });
}

export async function openUrl(url) {
  await Browser.open({ url });
}

#### FILE: src/telegram.js ####
/* Public Telegram channels, read from the official web preview (t.me/s/<name>):
   text, dates and forwarded-from (text only: pictures are not downloaded). Works without login; does NOT work for
   private channels or channels whose web preview is disabled. */
import { fetchHtml, setRate } from "./net.js";
import * as store from "./store.js";

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

export function parseChannel(input) {
  let s = String(input || "").trim();
  if (/t\.me\/(\+|joinchat)/i.test(s)) return null; // private invite link
  s = s.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, "").replace(/^(www\.)?(t|telegram)\.me\//i, "").replace(/^s\//, "").replace(/^@/, "");
  s = s.split(/[/?#]/)[0];
  return /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{3,}$/.test(s) ? s : null;
}

function nodeText(node) {
  let s = "";
  node.childNodes.forEach((c) => {
    if (c.nodeType === 3) s += c.textContent || "";
    else if (c.nodeType === 1) s += c.tagName === "BR" ? "\n" : nodeText(c);
  });
  return s;
}

const clean = (t) => String(t || "").replace(/\u00a0/g, " ").replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, "\n").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();

function bgUrl(el) {
  const m = /url\((['"]?)(.*?)\1\)/.exec((el && el.getAttribute("style")) || "");
  return m ? m[2].replace(/&amp;/g, "&") : "";
}

export function parsePage(html) {
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
  const title = clean(doc.querySelector(".tgme_channel_info_header_title")?.textContent) ||
    clean(doc.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]')?.getAttribute("content"));
  const desc = clean(doc.querySelector(".tgme_channel_info_description")?.textContent);
  const msgs = [];
  doc.querySelectorAll(".tgme_widget_message[data-post]").forEach((el) => {
    const id = Number(String(el.getAttribute("data-post")).split("/").pop());
    if (!id) return;
    const textEl = el.querySelector(".js-message_text");
    const photos = [];
    el.querySelectorAll("a.tgme_widget_message_photo_wrap").forEach((a) => { const u = bgUrl(a); if (u) photos.push(u); });
    let video = false;
    el.querySelectorAll(".tgme_widget_message_video_thumb,.tgme_widget_message_roundvideo_thumb").forEach((t) => {
      const u = bgUrl(t); video = true; if (u) photos.push(u);
    });
    if (!video && el.querySelector(".tgme_widget_message_video_wrap,.tgme_widget_message_roundvideo_wrap")) video = true;
    const lp = el.querySelector("a.tgme_widget_message_link_preview");
    msgs.push({
      msg_id: id,
      date: el.querySelector(".tgme_widget_message_date time")?.getAttribute("datetime") || el.querySelector("time")?.getAttribute("datetime") || "",
      text: textEl ? clean(nodeText(textEl)) : "",
      fwd: clean(el.querySelector(".tgme_widget_message_forwarded_from_name")?.textContent),
      views: clean(el.querySelector(".tgme_widget_message_views")?.textContent),
      photo_urls: photos,
      video,
      voice: !!el.querySelector(".tgme_widget_message_voice"),
      sticker: !!el.querySelector(".tgme_widget_message_sticker_wrap"),
      file: clean(el.querySelector(".tgme_widget_message_document_title")?.textContent),
      poll: clean(el.querySelector(".tgme_widget_message_poll_question")?.textContent),
      link: lp ? { url: lp.getAttribute("href") || "", title: clean(lp.querySelector(".link_preview_title")?.textContent) } : null,
      unsupported: !!el.querySelector(".message_media_not_supported_label"),
    });
  });
  const more = doc.querySelector("[data-before]");
  return { title, desc, msgs, nextBefore: more ? Number(more.getAttribute("data-before")) || 0 : 0 };
}

async function getPage(username, before) {
  const url = `https://t.me/s/${username}` + (before ? `?before=${before}` : "");
  let lastErr;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt++) {
    try {
      const { html } = await fetchHtml(url, 30000);
      return parsePage(html);
    } catch (e) {
      lastErr = e;
      await sleep(3000 * (attempt + 1)); // Telegram may rate-limit: wait and retry
    }
  }
  throw lastErr;
}

export async function runTelegram(project, { onProgress, shouldStop, incremental = false }) {
  await store.requestPersistence();
  setRate(project.delay_ms || 700);
  const username = project.tg_user;
  const limit = incremental ? 0 : Number(project.tg_limit) || 0;
  // incremental: start from the newest message and stop at the first one we already have
  let maxKnown = 0;
  if (incremental) {
    const old = await store.loadPages(project.id);
    maxKnown = old.reduce((m, x) => Math.max(m, x.msg_id || 0), 0);
  }
  let before = incremental ? 0 : project.tg_before || 0;
  let count = project.tg_count || 0;
  project.status = "downloading";
  let finished = false;
  let first = !incremental && !project.tg_started;
  let reachedKnown = false;
  let added = 0;

  while (!shouldStop()) {
    const page = await getPage(username, before);
    if (first) {
      if (!page.msgs.length) throw new Error("پیامی پیدا نشد. این کانال عمومی نیست، یا مدیر آن «پیش‌نمایش وب» را بسته، یا محتوایش محدود شده است. (کانال خصوصی پشتیبانی نمی‌شود.)");
      if (page.title) project.site_name = project.site_name || page.title;
      project.tg_desc = page.desc || "";
      project.tg_started = true;
      first = false;
    }
    if (!page.msgs.length) { finished = true; break; }

    // with a message limit, keep only the newest messages that still fit
    let msgs = page.msgs;
    if (limit && msgs.length > limit - count) msgs = [...msgs].sort((x, y) => y.msg_id - x.msg_id).slice(0, limit - count);
    const records = [];
    for (const m of msgs) {
      if (incremental && m.msg_id <= maxKnown) { reachedKnown = true; continue; }
      const rec = {
        id: `${project.id}|${m.msg_id}`, project_id: project.id, kind: "tg", order_index: m.msg_id,
        msg_id: m.msg_id, date: m.date, text: m.text, fwd: m.fwd, views: m.views, video: m.video,
        voice: m.voice, sticker: m.sticker, file: m.file, poll: m.poll, link: m.link, unsupported: m.unsupported,
        has_photo: m.photo_urls.length > 0 && !m.video, status: "extracted",
      };
      records.push(rec);
    }
    await store.savePages(records);
    count += records.length;
    added += records.length;
    const oldest = Math.min(...msgs.map((m) => m.msg_id));
    const oldestDate = msgs.find((m) => m.msg_id === oldest)?.date || "";
    before = oldest;
    if (incremental) Object.assign(project, { tg_count: count, updated: Date.now() });
    else Object.assign(project, { tg_before: oldest, tg_count: count, tg_oldest_date: oldestDate, updated: Date.now() });
    await store.saveProject(project);
    onProgress?.({ messages: count, oldest: incremental ? project.tg_oldest_date || "" : oldestDate });

    if (incremental && reachedKnown) { finished = true; break; }
    if ((limit && count >= limit) || oldest <= 1 || !page.nextBefore) { finished = true; break; }
  }

  if (incremental) project.last_incremental = { at: Date.now(), added };
  project.status = finished ? "ready" : "paused";
  if (finished) project.finished = Date.now();
  await store.saveProject(project);
  onProgress?.({ messages: count, oldest: project.tg_oldest_date || "", done: finished });
  return project;
}

#### FILE: src/tgExport.js ####
/* Word + PDF output for a downloaded Telegram channel (messages oldest -> newest). */
import { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, Bookmark, InternalHyperlink, CharacterSet } from "docx";
import { fontBytes, PERSIAN_FONT, fontFaceCss, BODY_FONT_STACK } from "./fonts.js";
import { run, para, detectRtl, FONT, fixEmbeddedFont } from "./docxBuilder.js";
import { faNum, faLongDate } from "./format.js";

const MAX_COUNT = 1000; // default messages per part (can be changed in Settings)

/* fill every part up to the limit (only the last one may be shorter) */
export function partitionMessages(msgs, maxPerPart = MAX_COUNT) {
  const max = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxPerPart) || MAX_COUNT);
  const sorted = [...msgs].sort((a, b) => a.msg_id - b.msg_id);
  const parts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i += max) parts.push({ msgs: sorted.slice(i, i + max) });
  return parts;
}

export const when = (iso) => {
  if (!iso) return "";
  try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }); }
  catch (_e) { return iso; }
};
export const monthOf = (iso) => {
  if (!iso) return "بدون تاریخ";
  try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long" }); }
  catch (_e) { return iso.slice(0, 7); }
};
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));

export function notes(m) {
  const n = [];
  if (m.has_photo) n.push("[تصویر — این آرشیو فقط متن را نگه می‌دارد]");
  if (m.video) n.push("[ویدیو — این آرشیو فقط متن را نگه می‌دارد]");
  if (m.voice) n.push("[پیام صوتی]");
  if (m.sticker) n.push("[استیکر]");
  if (m.file) n.push("[فایل: " + m.file + "]");
  if (m.poll) n.push("[نظرسنجی: " + m.poll + "]");
  if (m.unsupported) n.push("[رسانهٔ پشتیبانی‌نشده در پیش‌نمایش وب]");
  return n;
}

/* ---------- cover (shared text for Word and PDF) ---------- */
function coverInfo(project, parts) {
  return {
    name: project.site_name || project.tg_user,
    url: project.site_url,
    date: faLongDate(project.finished || project.created),
    total: parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.msgs.length, 0),
  };
}

/* ---------- Word ---------- */
export async function buildTgDocx({ project, parts, partIndex, onProgress }) {
  const part = parts[partIndex];
  const c = coverInfo(project, parts);
  const nameRtl = detectRtl(c.name, true);
  const children = [
    para(run("بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم", { bold: true, size: 44, color: "123F39" }), { center: true, before: 500, after: 60 }),
    para(run("الله مولانا و لا مولا لکم", { size: 30, color: "4D5C59" }), { center: true, after: 520 }),
    para(run(c.name, { bold: true, size: 56, color: "123F39", rtl: nameRtl }), { center: true, after: 160, rtl: nameRtl }),
    para(run(c.url, { ltr: true, size: 22, color: "4D5C59" }), { center: true, rtl: false }),
    para(run("تاریخ دانلود: " + c.date, { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
    para(run("تعداد پیام‌ها: " + faNum(c.total), { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
    para(run("تهیه شده توسط اپ فراکسینتوم", { bold: true, size: 26, color: "17625A" }), { center: true, after: 60 }),
  ];
  if (project.tg_desc) {
    const dr = detectRtl(project.tg_desc, true);
    children.push(para(run(project.tg_desc, { size: 22, color: "5D6B68", italics: true, rtl: dr }), { center: true, rtl: dr, before: 200 }));
  }
  if (parts.length > 1) children.push(para(run(`بخش ${faNum(partIndex + 1)} از ${faNum(parts.length)}`, { size: 24, color: "5D6B68" }), { center: true }));

  // clickable table of contents: one link per month
  const months = [];
  part.msgs.forEach((m) => { const mo = monthOf(m.date); if (!months.length || months[months.length - 1] !== mo) months.push(mo); });
  children.push(para(run("فهرست مطالب", { bold: true, size: 36, color: "123F39" }), { pageBreakBefore: true, after: 160 }));
  months.forEach((mo, i) => children.push(para(new InternalHyperlink({ anchor: `m${partIndex}_${i}`, children: [run(mo, { size: 24, color: "17625A" })] }), { after: 50 })));

  let month = "";
  let monthIdx = -1;
  let done = 0;
  let firstMonth = true;
  for (const m of part.msgs) {
    const mo = monthOf(m.date);
    if (mo !== month) {
      month = mo;
      monthIdx += 1;
      children.push(para([new Bookmark({ id: `m${partIndex}_${monthIdx}`, children: [run(mo, { bold: true, size: 36, color: "123F39" })] })], { heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, pageBreakBefore: true, before: 300, after: 120, keepNext: true }));
      firstMonth = false;
    }
    const metaBits = [`#${faNum(m.msg_id)}`, when(m.date)];
    if (m.fwd) metaBits.push("ارسال‌شده از: " + m.fwd);
    children.push(para(run(metaBits.filter(Boolean).join("  •  "), { size: 18, color: "7A8683" }), { after: 60, keepNext: true }));

    for (const line of String(m.text || "").split("\n")) {
      const t = line.trim();
      if (!t) continue;
      const r = detectRtl(t, true);
      children.push(para(run(t, { rtl: r }), { justify: true, rtl: r }));
    }
    for (const n of notes(m)) children.push(para(run(n, { size: 21, italics: true, color: "8A9492" }), { after: 80 }));
    if (m.link && (m.link.title || m.link.url)) {
      if (m.link.title) { const r = detectRtl(m.link.title, true); children.push(para(run(m.link.title, { size: 21, bold: true, color: "17625A", rtl: r }), { after: 20, rtl: r })); }
      if (m.link.url) children.push(para(run(m.link.url, { ltr: true, size: 18, color: "17625A" }), { after: 80, rtl: false }));
    }
    // thin separator line under each message
    children.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 160 }, border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 4, color: "DDD6C5", space: 4 } }, children: [new TextRun({ text: "", font: FONT, size: 8 })] }));
    done += 1;
    if (done % 10 === 0) { onProgress?.(done, part.msgs.length); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); }
  }
  onProgress?.(part.msgs.length, part.msgs.length);

  const doc = new Document({
    creator: "آرشیوساز",
    title: c.name,
    fonts: [{ name: PERSIAN_FONT, data: fontBytes(), characterSet: CharacterSet.ARABIC }],
    styles: { default: { document: { run: { font: FONT, size: 24 } } } },
    sections: [{ properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 1134, bottom: 1134, left: 1134, right: 1134 } } }, children }],
  });
  return fixEmbeddedFont(await Packer.toBlob(doc));
}

/* ---------- PDF (HTML that Android prints straight to a PDF file) ---------- */
export function buildTgHtml({ project, parts, partIndex }) {
  const part = parts[partIndex];
  const c = coverInfo(project, parts);
  const body = [];
  body.push(
    `<section class="cover"><p class="bism">بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم</p><p class="bism2">الله مولانا و لا مولا لکم</p>` +
    `<h1 dir="auto">${esc(c.name)}</h1><p class="src">${esc(c.url)}</p>` +
    `<p class="sub">تاریخ دانلود: ${esc(c.date)}</p><p class="sub">تعداد پیام‌ها: ${faNum(c.total)}</p>` +
    `<p class="sub fx">تهیه شده توسط اپ فراکسینتوم</p>` +
    (project.tg_desc ? `<p class="sub" dir="auto"><i>${esc(project.tg_desc)}</i></p>` : "") +
    (parts.length > 1 ? `<p class="sub">بخش ${faNum(partIndex + 1)} از ${faNum(parts.length)}</p>` : "") +
    `</section>`,
  );
  const monthsH = [];
  part.msgs.forEach((m) => { const mo = monthOf(m.date); if (!monthsH.length || monthsH[monthsH.length - 1] !== mo) monthsH.push(mo); });
  body.push(`<section class="tocpage"><h2>فهرست مطالب</h2>${monthsH.map((mo, i) => `<p><a href="#m${partIndex}_${i}">${esc(mo)}</a></p>`).join("")}</section>`);
  let month = "";
  let mi = -1;
  for (const m of part.msgs) {
    const mo = monthOf(m.date);
    if (mo !== month) { month = mo; mi += 1; body.push(`<h2 class="month" id="m${partIndex}_${mi}">${esc(mo)}</h2>`); }
    const meta = [`#${faNum(m.msg_id)}`, when(m.date)].concat(m.fwd ? ["ارسال‌شده از: " + m.fwd] : []).filter(Boolean).join(" • ");
    let h = `<div class="msg"><div class="meta">${esc(meta)}</div>`;
    String(m.text || "").split("\n").forEach((line) => { if (line.trim()) h += `<p dir="auto">${esc(line.trim())}</p>`; });
    notes(m).forEach((n) => { h += `<p class="note">${esc(n)}</p>`; });
    if (m.link && (m.link.title || m.link.url)) h += `<p dir="auto" class="lk"><b>${esc(m.link.title)}</b><br><span class="u">${esc(m.link.url)}</span></p>`;
    body.push(h + `</div>`);
  }
  return `<!doctype html><html lang="fa" dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${esc(c.name)}</title><style>` +
    `@page{size:A4;margin:16mm 14mm}` +
    fontFaceCss() + `body{font-family:${BODY_FONT_STACK};direction:rtl;text-align:start;font-size:12pt;line-height:1.9;color:#1b2523;margin:0}` +
    `p{margin:0 0 7pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-word}` +
    `.cover{text-align:center;page-break-after:always;padding-top:50px}.cover h1{font-size:30pt;color:#123f39;margin:0 0 8px}` +
    `.cover .src{direction:ltr;color:#4d5c59}.cover .sub{color:#5d6b68;margin:2px 0;text-align:center}.cover .fx{color:#17625a;font-weight:700}` +
    `.bism{font-size:22pt;color:#123f39;text-align:center}.bism2{font-size:15pt;color:#4d5c59;text-align:center;margin-bottom:30px}` +
    `.tocpage{page-break-before:always;page-break-after:always}.tocpage h2{font-size:18pt;border-bottom:2px solid #123f39}.tocpage a{color:#17625a;text-decoration:none}` +
    `.month{font-size:18pt;color:#123f39;margin:22px 0 8px;border-bottom:2px solid #123f39}` +
    `.msg{padding:8px 0 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd6c5}.meta{font-size:9pt;color:#7a8683;margin-bottom:3px}` +
    `.note{color:#8a9492;font-style:italic;font-size:10.5pt}.lk .u{direction:ltr;unicode-bidi:isolate;color:#17625a;font-size:9pt}` +
        `</style></head><body>${body.join("")}</body></html>`;
}

  groupSections, numberSections, partitionSections, buildPartHtml,
  buildPagesCsv, buildSitemapXml, documentSlug,

import { getSettings, setSetting, resetSettings, applySettings, pagesPerPart } from "./settings.js";
import {
  esc, drawerHtml, downloadsHtml, aboutHtml, settingsHtml, contactHtml, diagnosticText,
  storageHtml, updatesHtml, privacyHtml,
} from "./views.js";
import logoUrl from "./assets/logo.jpg";

const app = document.getElementById("app");
const S = {
  view: "home", menu: false, projects: [], project: null, running: false, stop: false,
  progress: null, error: "", parts: null, pages: null, msg: "", status: "", busy: "", update: null, mode: "site",
  downloads: [], storageEst: null,
};

const STATUS = { extracting: "در حال استخراج", ready: "کامل", paused: "متوقف", discovering: "در حال پیمایش سایت", discovered: "منتظر انتخاب سقف", downloading: "در حال دانلود" };
const TG_LIMITS = [500, 1000, 5000, 20000, 100000];
const LIMITS = [500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000, 150000, 200000, 250000, 500000];
const KIND_LABEL = { docx: "Word", pdf: "PDF", epub: "EPUB" };
const SLOGAN = "فراکسینتوم؛ جایی که عظمت مسلمانان از خاطره‌ی تاریخ، به نیروی آینده تبدیل می‌شود.";

function header() {
  return `<header class="top"><button class="burger" data-act="menu" aria-label="منو"><i></i><i></i><i></i></button><img class="logo" src="${logoUrl}" alt="FRAXINETUM" /><div><h1>FRAXINETUM</h1><div class="sub">آرشیو کامل یک سایت — Word و PDF و EPUB</div></div></header>`;
}

function updateHtml() {
  const u = S.update;
  if (!u) return "";
  if (!u.ok) return `<div class="note err">${esc(u.error)}</div>`;
  if (u.available) return `<div class="note warn">نسخهٔ جدید (شمارهٔ ${faNum(u.latest)}) آماده است. <button data-act="doupd" style="margin-top:8px">دانلود و نصب نسخهٔ جدید</button></div>`;
  return `<div class="note">برنامه به‌روز است.</div>`;
}

const UNFINISHED = ["discovering", "downloading", "extracting", "paused", "discovered"];
function unfinishedHtml() {
  const list = S.projects.filter((p) => UNFINISHED.includes(p.status));
  if (!list.length) return "";
  return `<div class="card warn"><b>کارهای ناتمام</b>${list.map((p) => `<div class="row between" style="margin-top:8px"><span class="title grow">${esc(p.site_name || p.domain)}</span><button data-act="resume" data-id="${p.id}">ادامه</button></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
}

const delayOptions = (cur) => [[500, "کم — نیم ثانیه"], [1000, "متوسط — ۱ ثانیه"], [2000, "زیاد — ۲ ثانیه"]]
  .map(([v, t]) => `<option value="${v}" ${Number(cur) === v ? "selected" : ""}>${t}</option>`).join("");

function homeHtml() {
  const st = getSettings();
  const list = S.projects.map((p) => `
    <div class="card">
      <div class="row between"><div class="title grow">${esc(p.site_name || p.domain)}</div><span class="chip">${STATUS[p.status] || p.status}</span></div>
      <div class="mut ltr">${esc(p.site_url)}</div>
      <div class="mut">${p.kind === "tg" ? `${faNum(p.tg_count || 0)} پیام` : p.max_pages ? `${faNum(p.extracted || 0)} از ${faNum(Math.min(p.max_pages, p.discovered || 0))} صفحه استخراج شد` : `${faNum(p.discovered || 0)} صفحه در سایت یافت شد`}${p.failed ? ` — ${faNum(p.failed)} ناموفق` : ""}</div>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button data-act="open" data-id="${p.id}">باز کردن</button><button class="dan" data-act="del" data-id="${p.id}">حذف</button></div>
    </div>`).join("");
  const tgForm = `<div class="card">
      <label>نشانی کانال عمومی تلگرام</label>
      <input id="tgurl" class="ltr" placeholder="https://t.me/channelname  یا  @channelname" />
      <label style="margin-top:10px">تعداد پیام</label>
      <select id="tglimit"><option value="0">همهٔ پیام‌های کانال</option>${TG_LIMITS.map((n) => `<option value="${n}">آخرین ${faNum(n)} پیام</option>`).join("")}</select>
      <label style="margin-top:10px">تأخیر بین درخواست‌ها (برای فشار نیاوردن به سایت)</label>
      <select id="delay">${delayOptions(st.delay)}</select>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="grow" data-act="tgnew">دانلود کانال</button></div>
      <div class="note">فقط کانال‌های عمومی که پیش‌نمایش وب دارند (نشانی t.me/s/…) پشتیبانی می‌شوند؛ کانال خصوصی نه. فقط متن پیام‌ها آرشیو می‌شود؛ عکس و ویدیو دانلود نمی‌شوند. هنگام دانلود برنامه را باز نگه دارید.</div>
      <div id="msg"></div>
    </div>`;
  const siteForm = `<div class="card">
      <label>نشانی سایت</label>
      <input id="url" class="ltr" inputmode="url" placeholder="https://example.com" />
      <label style="margin-top:10px"><input id="robots" type="checkbox" ${st.robots ? "checked" : ""} style="width:auto;margin-left:8px" />رعایت robots.txt سایت</label>
      <label style="margin-top:10px">تأخیر بین درخواست‌ها (برای فشار نیاوردن به سایت)</label>
      <select id="delay">${delayOptions(st.delay)}</select>
      <label style="margin-top:10px">روش دریافت صفحه‌ها</label>
      <select id="fmode"><option value="auto" selected>خودکار (پیشنهادی)</option><option value="browser">همیشه با مرورگر داخلی (کندتر؛ برای سایت‌های سخت‌گیر یا جاوااسکریپتی)</option></select>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="grow" data-act="new">پیمایش سایت و شمارش صفحات</button></div>
      <div class="note">ابتدا کل سایت پیمایش و تعداد صفحات شمرده می‌شود؛ بعد سقف تعداد صفحات را خودتان انتخاب می‌کنید. همهٔ کار روی خود گوشی انجام می‌شود و هنگام پیمایش باید برنامه را باز نگه دارید.</div>
      <div id="msg"></div>
    </div>`;
  const banner = S.update && S.update.ok && S.update.available ? `<div class="card" style="padding:4px 14px">${updateHtml()}</div>` : "";
  return `${header()}
    <div class="slogan">${SLOGAN}</div>
    ${banner}
    <div class="row" style="margin-bottom:10px"><button class="${S.mode === "site" ? "" : "sec"} grow" data-act="mode" data-m="site">وب‌سایت</button><button class="${S.mode === "tg" ? "" : "sec"} grow" data-act="mode" data-m="tg">کانال تلگرام</button></div>
    ${S.mode === "tg" ? tgForm : siteForm}
    ${unfinishedHtml()}
    <div class="mut" style="margin:6px 4px">پروژه‌های من</div>
    ${list || `<div class="card mut">هنوز پروژه‌ای نیست.</div>`}`;
}

function progressHtml() {
  const p = S.progress || {};
  const pr = S.project;
  if (!pr.discovery_done) {
    const disc = p.discovered ?? pr.discovered ?? 0;
    const scanned = p.scanned ?? pr.scanned ?? 0;
    return `<div class="stats" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"><div><b>${faNum(disc)}</b><span>صفحهٔ یافت‌شده</span></div><div><b>${faNum(scanned)}</b><span>صفحهٔ بررسی‌شده</span></div></div>`;
  }
  const disc = p.discovered ?? pr.discovered ?? 0;
  const target = p.target ?? Math.min(pr.max_pages || 0, disc);
  const ex = p.extracted ?? pr.extracted ?? 0;
  const fl = p.failed ?? pr.failed ?? 0;
  const pct = target ? Math.min(100, Math.round(((ex + fl) / target) * 100)) : 0;
  return `<div class="bar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>
    <div class="stats"><div><b>${faNum(disc)}</b><span>کل سایت</span></div><div><b>${faNum(ex)}</b><span>استخراج</span></div><div><b>${faNum(fl)}</b><span>ناموفق</span></div><div><b>${faNum(Math.max(0, target - ex - fl))}</b><span>باقی‌مانده</span></div></div>`;
}

function ceilingHtml() {
  const p = S.project;
  const total = p.discovered || 0;
  const cur = p.max_pages || 0;
  if (!p.discovery_done || S.running) return "";
  if (cur && (cur >= total || p.status === "extracting")) return "";
  const opts = [`<option value="all">همهٔ صفحات سایت (${faNum(total)} صفحه)</option>`]
    .concat(LIMITS.filter((n) => n < total && n > cur).map((n) => `<option value="${n}">${faNum(n)} صفحه</option>`));
  return `<div class="card">
    <b>${cur ? "افزایش سقف صفحات" : `کل سایت پیمایش شد: ${faNum(total)} صفحه${p.capped ? " (حداقل؛ سقف برنامه)" : ""}`}</b>
    <label style="margin-top:10px">سقف تعداد صفحاتی که استخراج شود</label>
    <select id="ceil">${opts.join("")}</select>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="grow" data-act="extract">${cur ? "ادامهٔ استخراج با سقف جدید" : "شروع استخراج"}</button></div>
  </div>`;
}

function refetchEmptyHtml(p) {
  if (S.running || p.kind === "tg" || !(p.extracted > 0) || !["ready", "paused"].includes(p.status)) return "";
  return `<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><button class="sec grow" data-act="refetch-empty">بازدریافت صفحه‌های بدون متن</button></div><div class="mut" style="margin-top:4px">صفحه‌هایی که پیش‌تر به‌خاطر پاسخ خالی یا مسدود سایت «بدون متن» ثبت شده‌اند دوباره از سایت گرفته می‌شوند.</div>`;
}

function incrementalHtml(p) {
  const li = p.last_incremental;
  const info = li ? `<div class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">آخرین به‌روزرسانی: ${faNum(li.added || 0)} صفحهٔ جدید${li.changed ? ` و ${faNum(li.changed)} صفحهٔ تغییرکرده` : ""}</div>` : "";
  if (S.running || p.status !== "ready") return info + refetchEmptyHtml(p);
  return `<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="sec grow" data-act="incr">به‌روزرسانی افزایشی (دانلود صفحات جدید)</button></div>${info}${refetchEmptyHtml(p)}`;
}

function projectHtml() {
  const p = S.project;
  const ready = (p.extracted || 0) > 0;
  const parts = S.parts
    ? S.parts.map((pt, i) => `<div class="row between" style="margin-top:8px"><span>بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} — ${faNum(pt.pageCount)} صفحه</span><span class="row">
        <button class="sec" data-act="word" data-i="${i}" ${S.busy ? "disabled" : ""}>Word</button>
        <button class="sec" data-act="pdf" data-i="${i}" ${S.busy ? "disabled" : ""}>PDF</button>
        <button class="sec" data-act="epub" data-i="${i}" ${S.busy ? "disabled" : ""}>EPUB</button></span></div>`).join("")
    : "";
  return `${header()}
    <button class="sec" data-act="back">← همهٔ پروژه‌ها</button>
    <div class="card" style="margin-top:10px">
      <div class="row between"><div class="title grow">${esc(p.site_name || p.domain)}</div><span class="chip">${STATUS[p.status] || p.status}</span></div>
      <div class="mut ltr">${esc(p.site_url)}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:6px"><button class="sec" data-act="rename">ویرایش نام سایت</button></div>
      <div id="prog">${progressHtml()}</div>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:12px">
        ${S.running
          ? `<button class="dan" data-act="stop">توقف</button>`
          : !p.discovery_done
            ? `<button data-act="discover">${p.seeded ? "ادامهٔ پیمایش سایت" : "شروع پیمایش"}</button>`
            : p.max_pages && p.status !== "ready" && p.status !== "discovered"
              ? `<button data-act="extract-resume">ادامهٔ استخراج</button>${p.failed ? `<button class="sec" data-act="retry">تلاش دوبارهٔ ناموفق‌ها</button>` : ""}`
              : `${p.failed ? `<button class="sec" data-act="retry">تلاش دوبارهٔ ناموفق‌ها</button>` : ""}`}
      </div>
      ${incrementalHtml(p)}
      ${S.error ? `<div class="note err">${esc(S.error)}</div>` : ""}
      ${p.last_error && !S.running ? `<div class="note err">${esc(p.last_error)}</div>` : ""}
    </div>
    ${ceilingHtml()}
    ${ready ? `<div class="card">
      <b>خروجی نهایی</b>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="grow" data-act="prepare" ${S.busy || S.running ? "disabled" : ""}>آماده‌سازی خروجی</button></div>
      ${parts}
      <hr/>
      <div class="row"><button class="sec grow" data-act="xml" ${S.busy ? "disabled" : ""}>نقشهٔ سایت (XML)</button><button class="sec grow" data-act="csv" ${S.busy ? "disabled" : ""}>فهرست لینک‌ها (CSV)</button></div>
      <div id="status" class="mut" style="margin-top:8px">${esc(S.status)}</div>
      ${S.msg ? `<div class="note">${esc(S.msg)}</div>` : ""}
      <div class="note">با زدن هر دکمه، فایل مستقیم در پوشهٔ Download/FRAXINETUM ذخیره می‌شود و در «دانلودها» (منوی کناری) با تاریخ می‌ماند. هر بخش تا ${faNum(pagesPerPart())} صفحه است و پُر پُر تقسیم می‌شود.</div>
    </div>` : ""}`;
}

function tgProjectHtml() {
  const p = S.project;
  const pr = S.progress || {};
  const count = pr.messages ?? p.tg_count ?? 0;
  const oldest = pr.oldest || p.tg_oldest_date || "";
  const oldestFa = oldest ? new Date(oldest).toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long" }) : "—";
  const parts = S.parts
    ? S.parts.map((pt, i) => `<div class="row between" style="margin-top:8px"><span>بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} — ${faNum(pt.msgs.length)} پیام</span><span class="row">
        <button class="sec" data-act="tgword" data-i="${i}" ${S.busy ? "disabled" : ""}>Word</button>
        <button class="sec" data-act="tgpdf" data-i="${i}" ${S.busy ? "disabled" : ""}>PDF</button>
        <button class="sec" data-act="tgepub" data-i="${i}" ${S.busy ? "disabled" : ""}>EPUB</button></span></div>`).join("")
    : "";
  return `${header()}
    <button class="sec" data-act="back">← همهٔ پروژه‌ها</button>
    <div class="card" style="margin-top:10px">
      <div class="row between"><div class="title grow">${esc(p.site_name || p.tg_user)}</div><span class="chip">${STATUS[p.status] || p.status}</span></div>
      <div class="mut ltr">${esc(p.site_url)}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:6px"><button class="sec" data-act="rename">ویرایش نام کانال</button></div>
      <div id="prog"><div class="stats" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"><div><b>${faNum(count)}</b><span>پیام</span></div><div><b>${esc(oldestFa)}</b><span>قدیمی‌ترین پیام</span></div></div></div>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:12px">
        ${S.running ? `<button class="dan" data-act="stop">توقف</button>` : p.status !== "ready" ? `<button data-act="tgstart">${p.tg_started ? "ادامهٔ دانلود" : "شروع دانلود"}</button>` : ""}
      </div>
      ${S.error ? `<div class="note err">${esc(S.error)}</div>` : ""}
      ${p.status === "ready" ? `<div class="note">دانلود کامل شد.</div>` : ""}
      ${incrementalHtml(p)}
    </div>
    ${count > 0 ? `<div class="card">
      <b>خروجی نهایی</b>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="grow" data-act="tgprepare" ${S.busy || S.running ? "disabled" : ""}>آماده‌سازی خروجی</button></div>
      ${parts}
      <div id="status" class="mut" style="margin-top:8px">${esc(S.status)}</div>
      ${S.msg ? `<div class="note">${esc(S.msg)}</div>` : ""}
      <div class="note">پیام‌ها از قدیم به جدید و به‌ترتیب ماه چیده می‌شوند. کانال به بخش‌های پُر تقسیم می‌شود و هر بخش را جدا می‌گیرید.</div>
    </div>` : ""}`;
}

function pageHtml() {
  const body = {
    downloads: () => downloadsHtml(S.downloads, isNative()),
    about: aboutHtml,
    settings: settingsHtml,
    contact: contactHtml,
    storage: () => storageHtml(S.storageEst, S.projects),
    updates: () => updatesHtml(updateHtml()),
    privacy: privacyHtml,
  }[S.view];
  return `${header()}<button class="sec" data-act="back">← بازگشت</button><div style="margin-top:10px">${body ? body() : ""}</div>`;
}

function render() {
  let body;
  if (S.view === "home") body = homeHtml();
  else if (S.view === "project") body = S.project.kind === "tg" ? tgProjectHtml() : projectHtml();
  else body = pageHtml();
  app.innerHTML = body + (S.menu ? drawerHtml(S.view === "project" ? "home" : S.view, logoUrl) : "");
}

function setStatus(t) {
  S.status = t;
  const el = document.getElementById("status");
  if (el) el.textContent = t;
}

function updateProgress() {
  const el = document.getElementById("prog");
  if (el) el.innerHTML = progressHtml();
}

async function refreshProjects() {
  S.projects = await store.listProjects();
}

async function navigate(v) {
  S.menu = false;
  S.project = null;
  if (v === "home") await refreshProjects();
  if (v === "downloads") S.downloads = await store.listDownloads();
  if (v === "storage") {
    await refreshProjects();
    try { S.storageEst = navigator.storage && navigator.storage.estimate ? await navigator.storage.estimate() : null; } catch (_e) { S.storageEst = null; }
  }
  S.view = v;
  render();
}

/* ---- in-app toast: "دانلود انجام شد" ---- */
function showToast({ title, text, kind, action }) {
  const old = document.querySelector(".toast");
  if (old) old.remove();
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "toast" + (kind === "err" ? " err" : "");
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="ck">${kind === "err" ? "!" : "✓"}</div><div class="tx"><b>${esc(title)}</b><span>${esc(text || "")}</span></div>${action ? `<button data-toast="${action}">دانلودها</button>` : ""}`;
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  el.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
    if (ev.target.closest("[data-toast]")) navigate("downloads");
    el.remove();
  });
  setTimeout(() => { el.classList.add("out"); setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 450); }, kind === "err" ? 8000 : 4500);
}
setToast(showToast);

async function openProject(id) {
  S.project = (await store.listProjects()).find((p) => p.id === id);
  S.view = "project"; S.menu = false; S.parts = null; S.pages = null; S.msg = ""; S.error = ""; S.progress = null; S.status = "";
  render();
}

async function newProject() {
  let raw = document.getElementById("url").value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById("msg");
  if (!raw) return;
  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) raw = "https://" + raw;
  let host = "";
  try { host = bareHost(raw); new URL(raw); } catch (_e) { if (msg) msg.innerHTML = `<div class="note err">نشانی معتبر نیست.</div>`; return; }
  const project = {
    id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
    respect_robots: document.getElementById("robots").checked, fetch_mode: document.getElementById("fmode").value, delay_ms: Number(document.getElementById("delay").value) || 500,
    site_url: raw, domain: host, site_name: "", max_pages: 0,
    status: "discovering", created: Date.now(), discovered: 0, extracted: 0, failed: 0,
    seeded: false, discovery_done: false, next_n: 0,
  };
  await store.saveProject(project);
  await openProject(project.id);
  runPhase("discover");
}

const phaseText = (p) => p.phase === "discover"
  ? `پیمایش سایت: ${faNum(p.discovered || 0)} صفحه`
  : `استخراج: ${faNum(p.extracted || 0)} از ${faNum(p.target || 0)} صفحه`;

async function runPhase(kind, retry = false) {
  if (S.running) return;
  S.running = true; S.stop = false; S.error = ""; render();
  await kaStart("FRAXINETUM — در حال کار روی سایت");
  const opts = { shouldStop: () => S.stop, onProgress: (p) => { S.progress = p; updateProgress(); kaUpdate(phaseText(p)); } };
  try {
    if (kind === "discover") await runDiscovery(S.project, opts);
    else if (kind === "incremental") await runIncremental(S.project, opts);
    else await runExtraction(S.project, { ...opts, retryFailed: retry });
  } catch (e) {
    S.error = String((e && e.message) || e);
    S.project.status = "paused";
    await store.saveProject(S.project);
  }
  await kaStop();
  S.running = false; S.parts = null; S.progress = null; render();
}

async function refetchEmpty() {
  const all = await store.loadPages(S.project.id);
  const empty = all.filter((p) => p.status === "extracted" && !p.word_count && p.order_index < (S.project.max_pages || 0));
  if (!empty.length) { showToast({ title: "صفحهٔ بدون متنی پیدا نشد", text: "همهٔ صفحه‌های استخراج‌شده متن دارند.", kind: "ok" }); return; }
  empty.forEach((p) => { p.status = "pending"; p.error = ""; });
  await store.savePages(empty);
  S.project.extracted = Math.max(0, (S.project.extracted || 0) - empty.length);
  S.project.status = "extracting";
  await store.saveProject(S.project);
  runPhase("extract");
}

async function chooseCeilingAndExtract() {
  const v = document.getElementById("ceil").value;
  S.project.max_pages = v === "all" ? S.project.discovered : Number(v);
  S.project.status = "extracting";
  await store.saveProject(S.project);
  runPhase("extract");
}

async function newTelegram() {
  const msg = document.getElementById("msg");
  const user = parseChannel(document.getElementById("tgurl").value);
  if (!user) { if (msg) msg.innerHTML = `<div class="note err">نشانی کانال معتبر نیست (لینک دعوت خصوصی پشتیبانی نمی‌شود).</div>`; return; }
  const project = {
    id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6), kind: "tg", delay_ms: Math.max(700, Number(document.getElementById("delay").value) || 700),
    site_url: `https://t.me/${user}`, domain: user, tg_user: user, site_name: "",
    tg_limit: Number(document.getElementById("tglimit").value) || 0,
    status: "downloading", created: Date.now(), tg_count: 0,
  };
  await store.saveProject(project);
  await openProject(project.id);
  runTg();
}

async function runTg(incremental = false) {
  if (S.running) return;
  S.running = true; S.stop = false; S.error = ""; render();
  await kaStart("FRAXINETUM — در حال دانلود کانال");
  try {
    await runTelegram(S.project, {
      incremental,
      shouldStop: () => S.stop,
      onProgress: (p) => {
        S.progress = p;
        kaUpdate(`دانلود کانال: ${faNum(p.messages)} پیام`);
        const el = document.getElementById("prog");
        if (el) {
          const fa = p.oldest ? new Date(p.oldest).toLocaleDateString("fa-IR", { year: "numeric", month: "long" }) : "—";
          el.innerHTML = `<div class="stats" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"><div><b>${faNum(p.messages)}</b><span>پیام</span></div><div><b>${esc(fa)}</b><span>قدیمی‌ترین پیام</span></div></div>`;
        }
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    S.error = String((e && e.message) || e);
    S.project.status = incremental ? "ready" : "paused";
    await store.saveProject(S.project);
  }
  await kaStop();
  S.running = false; S.parts = null; S.progress = null; render();
}

async function tgPrepare() {
  S.busy = "prepare"; setStatus("در حال بارگذاری پیام‌ها…");
  try {
    const all = (await store.loadPages(S.project.id)).filter((m) => m.kind === "tg");
    S.parts = partitionMessages(all);
    S.msg = `${faNum(all.length)} پیام در ${faNum(S.parts.length)} بخش آماده شد.`;
  } catch (e) { S.msg = String(e.message || e); }
  S.busy = ""; S.status = ""; render();
}

async function tgExportPart(i, kind) {
  S.busy = kind; S.msg = ""; render();
  const ext = { tgword: "docx", tgepub: "epub", tgpdf: "pdf" }[kind];
  const slug = documentSlug(S.project);
  const suffix = S.parts.length > 1 ? `-part-${i + 1}` : "";
  try {
    const part = S.parts[i];
    await runDownload({
      name: `${slug}${suffix}.${ext}`, mime: MIME[ext], project: S.project, label: `بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} (${KIND_LABEL[ext]})`,
      make: async (progress) => {
        const on = (n, t) => { setStatus(`ساخت ${ext.toUpperCase()}: ${faNum(n)} از ${faNum(t)}`); progress(n, t); };
        if (kind === "tgepub") return { blob: await buildTgEpub({ project: S.project, parts: S.parts, partIndex: i, onProgress: on }) };
        if (kind === "tgword") return { blob: await buildTgDocx({ project: S.project, parts: S.parts, partIndex: i, onProgress: on }) };
        setStatus("در حال ساخت PDF…");
        return { html: buildTgHtml({ project: S.project, parts: S.parts, partIndex: i }) };
      },
    });
    S.msg = `بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} (${faNum(part.msgs.length)} پیام) ذخیره شد.`;
  } catch (e) {
    S.msg = "ساخت فایل ناموفق بود: " + String((e && e.message) || e);
  }
  S.busy = ""; S.status = ""; render();
}

async function prepare() {
  S.busy = "prepare"; setStatus("در حال بارگذاری فهرست…");
  try {
    const all = await store.loadPages(S.project.id);
    S.pages = all.filter((p) => p.order_index < (S.project.max_pages || 0));
    const sections = groupSections(S.pages);
    numberSections(sections);
    const per = pagesPerPart();
    S.parts = partitionSections(sections, per);
    S.msg = S.parts.length > 1
      ? `${faNum(S.pages.length)} صفحه در ${faNum(S.parts.length)} بخش آماده شد (هر بخش تا ${faNum(per)} صفحه)؛ هر بخش را جدا بگیرید.`
      : "خروجی آماده است.";
  } catch (e) { S.msg = String(e.message || e); }
  S.busy = ""; S.status = ""; render();
}

async function loadPart(i) {
  const pages = S.parts[i].groups.flatMap((g) => g.pages);
  const ids = pages.filter((p) => (p.chunk_count || 0) > 0).map((p) => p.id);
  const map = await store.getContentMap(ids, (n, t) => setStatus(`بارگذاری متن: ${faNum(n)} از ${faNum(t)}`));
  pages.forEach((p) => { p.__content = map[p.id] || ""; });
  return pages;
}

async function exportPart(i, kind) {
  S.busy = kind; S.msg = ""; render();
  const ext = { word: "docx", epub: "epub", pdf: "pdf" }[kind];
  const slug = documentSlug(S.project);
  const suffix = S.parts.length > 1 ? `-part-${i + 1}` : "";
  try {
    await runDownload({
      name: `${slug}${suffix}.${ext}`, mime: MIME[ext], project: S.project, label: `بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} (${KIND_LABEL[ext]})`,
      make: async (progress) => {
        await loadPart(i);
        const on = (n, t) => { setStatus(`ساخت ${ext.toUpperCase()}: ${faNum(n)} از ${faNum(t)}`); progress(n, t); };
        if (kind === "word") {
          setStatus("در حال ساخت فایل Word…");
          const r = await buildDocxBlob({ project: S.project, parts: S.parts, partIndex: i, onProgress: on });
          return { blob: r.blob };
        }
        if (kind === "epub") {
          setStatus("در حال ساخت EPUB…");
          return { blob: await buildSiteEpub({ project: S.project, parts: S.parts, partIndex: i, onProgress: on }) };
        }
        setStatus("در حال ساخت PDF… (برای بخش‌های بزرگ چند دقیقه طول می‌کشد)");
        return { html: buildPartHtml({ project: S.project, parts: S.parts, partIndex: i }) };
      },
    });
    S.msg = `بخش ${faNum(i + 1)} (${faNum(S.parts[i].pageCount)} صفحه) ذخیره شد.`;
  } catch (e) {
    S.msg = "ساخت فایل ناموفق بود: " + String((e && e.message) || e);
  }
  S.busy = ""; S.status = ""; render();
}

async function exportSimple(kind) {
  try {
    const pages = await store.loadPages(S.project.id);
    const slug = documentSlug(S.project);
    const isCsv = kind === "csv";
    await runDownload({
      name: `${slug}${isCsv ? "-links.csv" : "-sitemap.xml"}`, mime: isCsv ? MIME.csv : MIME.xml, project: S.project,
      label: isCsv ? "فهرست لینک‌ها" : "نقشهٔ سایت",
      make: async () => ({ text: isCsv ? buildPagesCsv(pages) : buildSitemapXml(S.project, pages), mime: isCsv ? MIME.csv : MIME.xml }),
    });
    S.msg = isCsv ? "فهرست لینک‌ها ذخیره شد." : "نقشهٔ سایت ذخیره شد.";
  } catch (e) { S.msg = String((e && e.message) || e); }
  render();
}

app.addEventListener("click", async (ev) => {
  const b = ev.target.closest("[data-act]");
  if (!b) return;
  const act = b.dataset.act;
  if (act === "menu") { S.menu = !S.menu; return render(); }
  if (act === "closemenu") { S.menu = false; return render(); }
  if (act === "nav") return navigate(b.dataset.v);
  if (act === "new") return newProject();
  if (act === "open") return openProject(b.dataset.id);
  if (act === "del") {
    if (!confirm("این پروژه و همهٔ متن‌های آن از گوشی پاک شود؟")) return;
    await store.deleteProject(b.dataset.id); await refreshProjects(); return render();
  }
  if (act === "back") return navigate("home");
  if (act === "rename") {
    const n = prompt("نام (روی جلد فایل چاپ می‌شود):", S.project.site_name || S.project.domain);
    if (n && n.trim()) { S.project.site_name = n.trim(); await store.saveProject(S.project); render(); }
    return;
  }
  if (act === "checkupd") {
    S.update = null; const el = document.getElementById("upd"); if (el) el.innerHTML = `<div class="note">در حال بررسی…</div>`;
    S.update = await checkUpdate(); if (el) el.innerHTML = updateHtml(); return;
  }
  if (act === "doupd") return downloadUpdate();
  if (act === "battery") return openBatterySettings();
  if (act === "set") {
    const k = b.dataset.k;
    const v = k === "fontScale" ? Number(b.dataset.v) : b.dataset.v;
    setSetting(k, v); return render();
  }
  if (act === "set-reset") { resetSettings(); return render(); }
  if (act === "open-url") { try { await openUrl(b.dataset.u); } catch (_e) { /* no browser */ } return; }
  if (act === "copy-diag") {
    const el = document.getElementById("diag");
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(diagnosticText(`projects: ${S.projects.length}`)); if (el) el.textContent = "کپی شد."; }
    catch (_e) { if (el) el.textContent = diagnosticText(`projects: ${S.projects.length}`); }
    return;
  }
  if (act === "dl-open" || act === "dl-share") {
    const rec = S.downloads.find((d) => d.id === b.dataset.id);
    if (!rec) return;
    try { if (act === "dl-open") await openSaved(rec.uri, rec.mime); else await shareSaved(rec.uri, rec.name); }
    catch (e) { showToast({ title: act === "dl-open" ? "باز نشد" : "ارسال نشد", text: String((e && e.message) || e), kind: "err" }); }
    return;
  }
  if (act === "dl-del") { await store.deleteDownload(b.dataset.id); S.downloads = await store.listDownloads(); return render(); }
  if (act === "dl-clear") {
    if (!confirm("سابقهٔ دانلودها از این فهرست پاک شود؟ (فایل‌ها پاک نمی‌شوند)")) return;
    await store.clearDownloads(); S.downloads = []; return render();
  }
  if (act === "resume") {
    await openProject(b.dataset.id);
    const p = S.project;
    if (p.kind === "tg") return runTg();
    if (!p.discovery_done) return runPhase("discover");
    if (p.max_pages && p.status !== "discovered") return runPhase("extract");
    return;
  }
  if (act === "incr") return S.project.kind === "tg" ? runTg(true) : runPhase("incremental");
  if (act === "epub") return exportPart(Number(b.dataset.i), "epub");
  if (act === "tgepub") return tgExportPart(Number(b.dataset.i), "tgepub");
  if (act === "mode") { S.mode = b.dataset.m; return render(); }
  if (act === "tgnew") return newTelegram();
  if (act === "tgstart") return runTg();
  if (act === "tgprepare") return tgPrepare();
  if (act === "tgword" || act === "tgpdf") return tgExportPart(Number(b.dataset.i), act);
  if (act === "discover") return runPhase("discover");
  if (act === "extract") return chooseCeilingAndExtract();
  if (act === "extract-resume") return runPhase("extract");
  if (act === "refetch-empty") return refetchEmpty();
  if (act === "retry") return runPhase("extract", true);
  if (act === "stop") { S.stop = true; return; }
  if (act === "prepare") return prepare();
  if (act === "word") return exportPart(Number(b.dataset.i), "word");
  if (act === "pdf") return exportPart(Number(b.dataset.i), "pdf");
  if (act === "xml" || act === "csv") return exportSimple(act);
});

app.addEventListener("change", (ev) => {
  const t = ev.target;
  if (t.dataset && t.dataset.set) { const n = Number(t.value); setSetting(t.dataset.set, Number.isNaN(n) ? t.value : n); render(); return; }
  if (t.dataset && t.dataset.setchk) { setSetting(t.dataset.setchk, !!t.checked); }
});

(async () => {
  applySettings();
  await refreshProjects();
  render();
  // silent update check on start (only shows a banner if a newer build exists)
  if (getSettings().checkUpdate) {
    checkUpdate().then((u) => { if (u.ok && u.available) { S.update = u; if (S.view === "home") render(); } });
  }
})();
